1.zh: 乌斯地有一个人名叫约伯；那人完全正直，敬畏　神，远离恶事。
1.en: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and turned away from evil.

1.zh: 他生了七个儿子，三个女儿。
1.en: There were born to him seven sons and three daughters.

1.zh: 他的家产有七千羊，三千骆驼，五百对牛，五百母驴，并有许多仆婢。这人在东方人中就为至大。
1.en: His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east.

1.zh: 他的儿子按着日子各在自己家里设摆筵宴，就打发人去，请了他们的三个姊妹来，与他们一同吃喝。
1.en: His sons went and held a feast in the house of each one on his birthday; and they sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

1.zh: 筵宴的日子过了，约伯打发人去叫他们自洁。他清早起来，按着他们众人的数目献燔祭；因为他说：「恐怕我儿子犯了罪，心中弃掉　神。」约伯常常这样行。
1.en: It was so, when the days of their feasting had run their course, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all. For Job said, “It may be that my sons have sinned, and renounced God in their hearts.” Job did so continually.

1.zh: 有一天，　神的众子来侍立在耶和华面前，撒但也来在其中。
1.en: Now on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before the LORD, Satan also came among them.

1.zh: 耶和华问撒但说：「你从哪里来？」撒但回答说：「我从地上走来走去，往返而来。」
1.en: The LORD said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

1.zh: 耶和华问撒但说：「你曾用心察看我的仆人约伯没有？地上再没有人像他完全正直，敬畏　神，远离恶事。」
1.en: The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant, Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil.”

1.zh: 撒但回答耶和华说：「约伯敬畏　神，岂是无故呢？
1.en: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, “Does Job fear God for nothing?

1.zh: 你岂不是四面圈上篱笆围护他和他的家，并他一切所有的吗？他手所做的都蒙你赐福；他的家产也在地上增多。
1.en: Haven’t you made a hedge around him, and around his house, and around all that he has, on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

1.zh: 你且伸手毁他一切所有的；他必当面弃掉你。」
1.en: But stretch out your hand now, and touch all that he has, and he will renounce you to your face.”

1.zh: 耶和华对撒但说：「凡他所有的都在你手中；只是不可伸手加害于他。」于是撒但从耶和华面前退去。
1.en: The LORD said to Satan, “Behold, all that he has is in your power. Only on himself don’t stretch out your hand.” So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD.

1.zh: 有一天，约伯的儿女正在他们长兄的家里吃饭喝酒，
1.en: It fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,

1.zh: 有报信的来见约伯，说：「牛正耕地，驴在旁边吃草，
1.en: that a messenger came to Job, and said, “The oxen were plowing, and the donkeys feeding beside them,

1.zh: 示巴人忽然闯来，把牲畜掳去，并用刀杀了仆人；惟有我一人逃脱，来报信给你。」
1.en: and the Sabeans attacked, and took them away. Yes, they have killed the servants with the edge of the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

1.zh: 他还说话的时候，又有人来说：「　神从天上降下火来，将群羊和仆人都烧灭了；惟有我一人逃脱，来报信给你。」
1.en: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The fire of God has fallen from the sky, and has burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

1.zh: 他还说话的时候，又有人来说：「迦勒底人分作三队忽然闯来，把骆驼掳去，并用刀杀了仆人；惟有我一人逃脱，来报信给你。」
1.en: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The Chaldeans made three bands, and swept down on the camels, and have taken them away, yes, and killed the servants with the edge of the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

1.zh: 他还说话的时候，又有人来说：「你的儿女正在他们长兄的家里吃饭喝酒，
1.en: While he was still speaking, there came also another, and said, “Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,

1.zh: 不料，有狂风从旷野刮来，击打房屋的四角，房屋倒塌在少年人身上，他们就都死了；惟有我一人逃脱，来报信给你。」
1.en: and behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell on the young men, and they are dead. I alone have escaped to tell you.”

1.zh: 约伯便起来，撕裂外袍，剃了头，伏在地上下拜，
1.en: Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped.

1.zh: 说：「我赤身出于母胎，也必赤身归回；赏赐的是耶和华，收取的也是耶和华。耶和华的名是应当称颂的。」
1.en: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away. Blessed be the LORD’s name.”

1.zh: 在这一切的事上约伯并不犯罪，也不以　神为愚妄。
1.en: In all this, Job didn’t sin, nor charge God with wrongdoing.

2.zh: 又有一天，　神的众子来侍立在耶和华面前，撒但也来在其中。
2.en: Again, on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before the LORD, Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD.

2.zh: 耶和华问撒但说：「你从哪里来？」撒但回答说：「我从地上走来走去，往返而来。」
2.en: The LORD said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Satan answered the LORD, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

2.zh: 耶和华问撒但说：「你曾用心察看我的仆人约伯没有？地上再没有人像他完全正直，敬畏　神，远离恶事。你虽激动我攻击他，无故地毁灭他，他仍然持守他的纯正。」
2.en: The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil. He still maintains his integrity, although you incited me against him, to ruin him without cause.”

2.zh: 撒但回答耶和华说：「人以皮代皮，情愿舍去一切所有的，保全性命。
2.en: Satan answered the LORD, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.

2.zh: 你且伸手伤他的骨头和他的肉，他必当面弃掉你。」
2.en: But stretch out your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will renounce you to your face.”

2.zh: 耶和华对撒但说：「他在你手中，只要存留他的性命。」
2.en: The LORD said to Satan, “Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life.”

2.zh: 于是撒但从耶和华面前退去，击打约伯，使他从脚掌到头顶长毒疮。
2.en: So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.

2.zh: 约伯就坐在炉灰中，拿瓦片刮身体。
2.en: He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.

2.zh: 他的妻子对他说：「你仍然持守你的纯正吗？你弃掉　神，死了吧！」
2.en: Then his wife said to him, “Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die.”

2.zh: 约伯却对她说：「你说话像愚顽的妇人一样。嗳！难道我们从　神手里得福，不也受祸吗？」在这一切的事上约伯并不以口犯罪。
2.en: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job didn’t sin with his lips.

2.zh: 约伯的三个朋友—提幔人以利法、书亚人比勒达、拿玛人琐法—听说有这一切的灾祸临到他身上，各人就从本处约会同来，为他悲伤，安慰他。
2.en: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.

2.zh: 他们远远地举目观看，认不出他来，就放声大哭。各人撕裂外袍，把尘土向天扬起来，落在自己的头上。
2.en: When they lifted up their eyes from a distance, and didn’t recognize him, they raised their voices, and wept; and they each tore his robe, and sprinkled dust on their heads toward the sky.

2.zh: 他们就同他七天七夜坐在地上，一个人也不向他说句话，因为他极其痛苦。
2.en: So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his grief was very great.

3.zh: 此后，约伯开口咒诅自己的[生]日，
3.en: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.

3.zh: 说：
3.en: Job answered:

3.zh: 愿我生的那日 和说怀了男胎的那夜都灭没。
3.en: “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’

3.zh: 愿那日变为黑暗； 愿　神不从上面寻找它； 愿亮光不照于其上。
3.en: Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.

3.zh: 愿黑暗和死荫索取那日； 愿密云停在其上； 愿日蚀恐吓它。
3.en: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes the day black terrify it.

3.zh: 愿那夜被幽暗夺取， 不在年中的日子同乐， 也不入月中的数目。
3.en: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.

3.zh: 愿那夜没有生育， 其间也没有欢乐的声音。
3.en: Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.

3.zh: 愿那咒诅日子且能惹动鳄鱼的 咒诅那夜。
3.en: Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.

3.zh: 愿那夜黎明的星宿变为黑暗， 盼亮却不亮， 也不见早晨的光线；
3.en: Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,

3.zh: 因没有把怀我胎的门关闭， 也没有将患难对我的眼隐藏。
3.en: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.

3.zh: 我为何不出[母]胎而死？ 为何不出[母]腹绝气？
3.en: “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?

3.zh: 为何有膝接收我？ 为何有奶哺养我？
3.en: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?

3.zh: 不然，我就早已躺卧安睡，
3.en: For now I should have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,

3.zh: 和地上为自己重造荒邱的君王、谋士，
3.en: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;

3.zh: 或与有金子、将银子装满了房屋的王子 一同安息；
3.en: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver;

3.zh: 或像隐而未现、不到期而落的胎， 归于无有，如同未见光的婴孩。
3.en: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.

3.zh: 在那里恶人止息搅扰， 困乏人得享安息，
3.en: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.

3.zh: 被囚的人同得安逸， 不听见督工的声音。
3.en: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.

3.zh: 大小都在那里； 奴仆脱离主人的辖制。
3.en: The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.

3.zh: 受患难的人为何有光赐给他呢？ 心中愁苦的人为何有生命赐给他呢？
3.en: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,

3.zh: 他们切望死，却不得死； 求死，胜于求隐藏的珍宝。
3.en: who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,

3.zh: 他们寻见坟墓就快乐， 极其欢喜。
3.en: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

3.zh: 人的道路既然遮隐， 　神又把他四面围困， [为何有光赐给]他呢？
3.en: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?

3.zh: 我未曾吃饭就发出叹息； 我唉哼[的声音]涌出如水。
3.en: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.

3.zh: 因我所恐惧的临到我身， 我所惧怕的迎我而来。
3.en: For the thing which I fear comes on me, that which I am afraid of comes to me.

3.zh: 我不得安逸，不得平静， 也不得安息，却有患难来到。
3.en: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither do I have rest; but trouble comes.”

4.zh: 提幔人以利法回答说：
4.en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

4.zh: 人若想与你说话，你就厌烦吗？ 但谁能忍住不说呢？
4.en: “If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?

4.zh: 你素来教导许多的人， 又坚固软弱的手。
4.en: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.

4.zh: 你的言语曾扶助那将要跌倒的人； 你又使软弱的膝稳固。
4.en: Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.

4.zh: 但现在祸患临到你，你就昏迷， 挨近你，你便惊惶。
4.en: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.

4.zh: 你的倚靠不是在你敬畏　[神]吗？ 你的盼望不是在你行事纯正吗？
4.en: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?

4.zh: 请你追想：无辜的人有谁灭亡？ 正直的人在何处剪除？
4.en: “Remember, now, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?

4.zh: 按我所见，耕罪孽、种毒害的人 都照样收割。
4.en: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble, reap the same.

4.zh: 神一出气，他们就灭亡； 　神一发怒，他们就消没。
4.en: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.

4.zh: 狮子的吼叫和猛狮的声音[尽都止息]； 少壮狮子的牙齿也都敲掉。
4.en: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

4.zh: 老狮子因绝食而死； 母狮之子也都离散。
4.en: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.

4.zh: 我暗暗地得了默示； 我耳朵也听其细微的声音。
4.en: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.

4.zh: 在思念夜中、异象之间， 世人沉睡的时候，
4.en: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,

4.zh: 恐惧、战兢临到我身， 使我百骨打战。
4.en: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.

4.zh: 有灵从我面前经过， 我身上的毫毛直立。
4.en: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.

4.zh: 那灵停住， 我却不能辨其形状； 有影像在我眼前。 我在静默中听见有声音[说]：
4.en: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,

4.zh: 必死的人岂能比　神公义吗？ 人岂能比造他的主洁净吗？
4.en: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?

4.zh: 主不信靠他的臣仆， 并且指他的使者为愚昧；
4.en: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.

4.zh: 何况那住在土房、根基在尘土里、 被蠹虫所毁坏的人呢？
4.en: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!

4.zh: 早晚之间，就被毁灭， 永归无有，无人理会。
4.en: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.

4.zh: 他帐棚的绳索岂不从中抽出来呢？ 他死，且是无智慧而死。
4.en: Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’

5.zh: 你且呼求，有谁答应你？ 诸圣者之中，你转向哪一位呢？
5.en: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?

5.zh: 忿怒害死愚妄人； 嫉妒杀死痴迷人。
5.en: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.

5.zh: 我曾见愚妄人扎下根， 但我忽然咒诅他的住处。
5.en: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

5.zh: 他的儿女远离稳妥的地步， 在城门口被压，并无人搭救。
5.en: His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,

5.zh: 他的庄稼有饥饿的人吃尽了， 就是在荆棘里的也抢去了； 他的财宝有网罗张口吞灭了。
5.en: whose harvest the hungry eat up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.

5.zh: 祸患原不是从土中出来； 患难也不是从地里发生。
5.en: For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;

5.zh: 人生在世必遇患难， 如同火星飞腾。
5.en: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

5.zh: 至于我，我必仰望　神， 把我的事情托付他。
5.en: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,

5.zh: 他行大事不可测度， 行奇事不可胜数：
5.en: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;

5.zh: 降雨在地上， 赐水于田里；
5.en: who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;

5.zh: 将卑微的安置在高处， 将哀痛的举到稳妥之地；
5.en: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.

5.zh: 破坏狡猾人的计谋， 使他们所谋的不得成就。
5.en: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, so that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.

5.zh: 他叫有智慧的中了自己的诡计， 使狡诈人的计谋速速灭亡。
5.en: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

5.zh: 他们白昼遇见黑暗， 午间摸索如在夜间。
5.en: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.

5.zh: 神拯救穷乏人 脱离他们口中的刀和强暴人的手。
5.en: But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.

5.zh: 这样，贫寒的人有指望， 罪孽之辈必塞口无言。
5.en: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.

5.zh: 神所惩治的人是有福的！ 所以你不可轻看全能者的管教。
5.en: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.

5.zh: 因为他打破，又缠裹； 他击伤，用手医治。
5.en: For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.

5.zh: 你六次遭难，他必救你； 就是七次，灾祸也无法害你。
5.en: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.

5.zh: 在饥荒中，他必救你脱离死亡； 在争战中，他必救你脱离刀剑的权力。
5.en: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.

5.zh: 你必被隐藏，不受口舌之害； 灾殃临到，你也不惧怕。
5.en: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.

5.zh: 你遇见灾害饥馑，就必嬉笑； 地上的野兽，你也不惧怕。
5.en: You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.

5.zh: 因为你必与田间的石头立约； 田里的野兽也必与你和好。
5.en: For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you.

5.zh: 你必知道你帐棚平安， 要查看你的羊圈，一无所失；
5.en: You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.

5.zh: 也必知道你的后裔将来发达， 你的子孙像地上的青草。
5.en: You will know also that your offspring will be great, your offspring as the grass of the earth.

5.zh: 你必寿高年迈才归坟墓， 好像禾捆到时收藏。
5.en: You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.

5.zh: 这理，我们已经考察，本是如此。 你须要听，要知道是与自己有益。
5.en: Behold, we have researched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”

6.zh: 约伯回答说：
6.en: Then Job answered,

6.zh: 惟愿我的烦恼称一称， 我一切的灾害放在天平里；
6.en: “Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!

6.zh: 现今都比海沙更重， 所以我的言语急躁。
6.en: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore my words have been rash.

6.zh: 因全能者的箭射入我身； 其毒，我的灵喝尽了； 　神的惊吓摆阵攻击我。
6.en: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in array against me.

6.zh: 野驴有草岂能叫唤？ 牛有料岂能吼叫？
6.en: Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder?

6.zh: 物淡而无盐岂可吃吗？ 蛋青有什么滋味呢？
6.en: Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

6.zh: 看为可厌的食物， 我心不肯挨近。
6.en: My soul refuses to touch them. They are as loathsome food to me.

6.zh: 惟愿我得着所求的， 愿　神赐我所切望的；
6.en: “Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for,

6.zh: 就是愿　神把我压碎， 伸手将我剪除。
6.en: even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

6.zh: 我因没有违弃那圣者的言语， 就仍以此为安慰， 在不止息的痛苦中还可踊跃。
6.en: Let it still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn’t spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

6.zh: 我有什么气力使我等候？ 我有什么结局使我忍耐？
6.en: What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?

6.zh: 我的气力岂是石头的气力？ 我的肉身岂是铜的呢？
6.en: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze?

6.zh: 在我岂不是毫无帮助吗？ 智慧岂不是从我心中赶出净尽吗？
6.en: Isn’t it that I have no help in me, that wisdom is driven away from me?

6.zh: 那将要灰心、离弃全能者、 不敬畏　神的人， 他的朋友当以慈爱待他。
6.en: “To him who is ready to faint, kindness should be shown from his friend; even to him who forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

6.zh: 我的弟兄诡诈，好像溪水， 又像溪水流干的河道。
6.en: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;

6.zh: 这河因结冰发黑， 有雪藏在其中；
6.en: which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.

6.zh: 天气渐暖就随时消化， 日头炎热便从原处干涸。
6.en: In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

6.zh: 结伴的客旅[离弃大道]， 顺河偏行，到荒野之地死亡。
6.en: The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish.

6.zh: 提玛结伴的客旅瞻望； 示巴同伙的人等候。
6.en: The caravans of Tema looked. The companies of Sheba waited for them.

6.zh: 他们因失了盼望就抱愧， 来到那里便蒙羞。
6.en: They were distressed because they were confident. They came there, and were confounded.

6.zh: 现在你们正是这样， 看见惊吓的事便惧怕。
6.en: For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid.

6.zh: 我岂说：请你们供给我， 从你们的财物中送礼物给我？
6.en: Did I ever say, ‘Give to me’? or, ‘Offer a present for me from your substance’?

6.zh: 岂说：拯救我脱离敌人的手吗？ 救赎我脱离强暴人的手吗？
6.en: or, ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors’?

6.zh: 请你们教导我，我便不作声； 使我明白在何事上有错。
6.en: “Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error.

6.zh: 正直的言语力量何其大！ 但你们责备是责备什么呢？
6.en: How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?

6.zh: 绝望人的讲论既然如风， 你们还想要驳正言语吗？
6.en: Do you intend to reprove words, since the speeches of one who is desperate are as wind?

6.zh: 你们想为孤儿拈阄， 以朋友当货物。
6.en: Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend.

6.zh: 现在请你们看看我， 我决不当面说谎。
6.en: Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.

6.zh: 请你们转意，不要不公； 请再转意，我的事有理。
6.en: Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.

6.zh: 我的舌上岂有不义吗？ 我的口里岂不辨奸恶吗？
6.en: Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?

7.zh: 人在世上岂无争战吗？ 他的日子不像雇工人的日子吗？
7.en: “Isn’t a man forced to labor on earth? Aren’t his days like the days of a hired hand?

7.zh: 像奴仆切慕黑影， 像雇工人盼望工价；
7.en: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages,

7.zh: 我也照样经过困苦的日月， 夜间的疲乏为我而定。
7.en: so I am made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.

7.zh: 我躺卧的时候便说： 我何时起来，黑夜就过去呢？ 我尽是反来复去，直到天亮。
7.en: When I lie down, I say, ‘When will I arise, and the night be gone?’ I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.

7.zh: 我的肉体以虫子和尘土为衣； 我的皮肤才收了口又重新破裂。
7.en: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.

7.zh: 我的日子比梭更快， 都消耗在无指望之中。
7.en: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.

7.zh: 求你想念，我的生命不过是一口气； 我的眼睛必不再见福乐。
7.en: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.

7.zh: 观看我的人，他的眼必不再见我； 你的眼目要看我，我却不在了。
7.en: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.

7.zh: 云彩消散而过； 照样，人下阴间也不再上来。
7.en: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more.

7.zh: 他不再回自己的家； 故土也不再认识他。
7.en: He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.

7.zh: 我不禁止我口； 我灵愁苦，要发出言语； 我心苦恼，要吐露哀情。
7.en: “Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

7.zh: 我[对　神说]：我岂是洋海， 岂是大鱼，你竟防守我呢？
7.en: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?

7.zh: 若说：我的床必安慰我， 我的榻必解释我的苦情，
7.en: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint,’

7.zh: 你就用梦惊骇我， 用异象恐吓我，
7.en: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me through visions,

7.zh: 甚至我宁肯噎死，宁肯死亡， 胜似留我[这一身的]骨头。
7.en: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.

7.zh: 我厌弃[性命]，不愿永活。 你任凭我吧，因我的日子都是虚空。
7.en: I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.

7.zh: 人算什么，你竟看他为大， 将他放在心上？
7.en: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,

7.zh: 每早鉴察他， 时刻试验他？
7.en: that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?

7.zh: 你到何时才转眼不看我， 才任凭我咽下唾沫呢？
7.en: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?

7.zh: 鉴察人的主啊，我若有罪，于你何妨？ 为何以我当你的箭靶子， 使我厌弃自己的性命？
7.en: If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden to myself?

7.zh: 为何不赦免我的过犯， 除掉我的罪孽？ 我现今要躺卧在尘土中； 你要殷勤地寻找我，我却不在了。
7.en: Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now will I lie down in the dust. You will seek me diligently, but I will not be.”

8.zh: 书亚人比勒达回答说：
8.en: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

8.zh: 这些话你要说到几时？ 口中的言语[如]狂风[要到几时呢]？
8.en: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?

8.zh: 神岂能偏离公平？ 全能者岂能偏离公义？
8.en: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?

8.zh: 或者你的儿女得罪了他； 他使他们受报应。
8.en: If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.

8.zh: 你若殷勤地寻求　神， 向全能者恳求；
8.en: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.

8.zh: 你若清洁正直， 他必定为你起来， 使你公义的居所兴旺。
8.en: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.

8.zh: 你起初虽然微小， 终久必甚发达。
8.en: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.

8.zh: 请你考问前代， 追念他们的列祖所查究的。
8.en: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.

8.zh: 我们不过从昨日才有，一无所知； 我们在世的日子好像影儿。
8.en: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)

8.zh: 他们岂不指教你，告诉你， 从心里发出言语来呢？
8.en: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?

8.zh: 蒲草没有泥岂能发长？ 芦荻没有水岂能生发？
8.en: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?

8.zh: 尚青的时候，还没有割下， 比百样的草先枯槁。
8.en: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.

8.zh: 凡忘记　神的人，景况也是这样； 不虔敬人的指望要灭没。
8.en: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,

8.zh: 他所仰赖的必折断； 他所倚靠的是蜘蛛网。
8.en: whose confidence will break apart, whose trust is a spider’s web.

8.zh: 他要倚靠房屋，房屋却站立不住； 他要抓住房屋，房屋却不能存留。
8.en: He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.

8.zh: 他在日光之下发青， 蔓子爬满了园子；
8.en: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.

8.zh: 他的根盘绕[石]堆， 扎入石地。
8.en: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.

8.zh: 他若从本地被拔出， 那地就不认识他，[说]： 我没有见过你。
8.en: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’

8.zh: 看哪，这就是他道中之乐； 以后必另有人从地而生。
8.en: Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring.

8.zh: 神必不丢弃完全人， 也不扶助邪恶人。
8.en: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.

8.zh: 他还要以喜笑充满你的口， 以欢呼充满你的嘴。
8.en: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.

8.zh: 恨恶你的要披戴惭愧； 恶人的帐棚必归于无有。
8.en: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”

9.zh: 约伯回答说：
9.en: Then Job answered,

9.zh: 我真知道是这样； 但人在　神面前怎能成为义呢？
9.en: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?

9.zh: 若愿意与他争辩， 千中之一也不能回答。
9.en: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.

9.zh: 他心里有智慧，且大有能力。 谁向　神刚硬而得亨通呢？
9.en: God is wise in heart, and mighty in strength. Who has hardened himself against him and prospered?

9.zh: 他发怒，把山翻倒挪移， 山并不知觉。
9.en: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.

9.zh: 他使地震动，离其本位， 地的柱子就摇撼。
9.en: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.

9.zh: 他吩咐日头不出来，就不出来， 又封闭众星。
9.en: He commands the sun and it doesn’t rise, and seals up the stars.

9.zh: 他独自铺张苍天， 步行在海浪之上。
9.en: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.

9.zh: 他造北斗、参星、昴星， 并南方的密宫；
9.en: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.

9.zh: 他行大事，不可测度， 行奇事，不可胜数。
9.en: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number.

9.zh: 他从我旁边经过，我却不看见； 他在我面前行走，我倒不知觉。
9.en: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.

9.zh: 他夺取，谁能阻挡？ 谁敢问他：你做什么？
9.en: Behold, he snatches away. Who can hinder him? Who will ask him, ‘What are you doing?’

9.zh: 神必不收回他的怒气； 扶助拉哈伯的，屈身在他以下。
9.en: “God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.

9.zh: 既是这样，我怎敢回答他， 怎敢选择言语与他[辩论呢]？
9.en: How much less will I answer him, and choose my words to argue with him?

9.zh: 我虽有义，也不回答他， 只要向那审判我的恳求。
9.en: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.

9.zh: 我若呼吁，他应允我； 我仍不信他真听我的声音。
9.en: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.

9.zh: 他用暴风折断我， 无故地加增我的损伤。
9.en: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.

9.zh: 我就是喘一口气，他都不容， 倒使我满心苦恼。
9.en: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.

9.zh: [若论]力量，[他真有]能力！ 若论审判，[他说]谁能将我传来呢？
9.en: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’

9.zh: 我虽有义，自己的口要定我为有罪； 我虽完全，我口必显我为弯曲。
9.en: Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse.

9.zh: 我本完全，不顾自己； 我厌恶我的性命。
9.en: I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.

9.zh: [善恶无分]，都是一样； 所以我说，完全人和恶人，他都灭绝。
9.en: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.

9.zh: 若忽然遭杀害之祸， 他必戏笑无辜的人遇难。
9.en: If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.

9.zh: 世界交在恶人手中； 蒙蔽世界审判官的脸， 若不是他，是谁呢？
9.en: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?

9.zh: 我的日子比跑信的更快， 急速过去，不见福乐。
9.en: “Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away. They see no good.

9.zh: 我的日子过去如快船， 如急落抓食的鹰。
9.en: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.

9.zh: 我若说：我要忘记我的哀情， 除去我的[愁容]，心中畅快；
9.en: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up,’

9.zh: 我因愁苦而惧怕， 知道你必不以我为无辜。
9.en: I am afraid of all my sorrows. I know that you will not hold me innocent.

9.zh: 我必被你定为有罪， 我何必徒然劳苦呢？
9.en: I will be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain?

9.zh: 我若用雪水洗身， 用硷洁净我的手，
9.en: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,

9.zh: 你还要扔我在坑里， 我的衣服都憎恶我。
9.en: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.

9.zh: 他本不像我是人，使我可以回答他， 又使我们可以同听审判。
9.en: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.

9.zh: 我们中间没有听讼的人 可以向我们两造按手。
9.en: There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.

9.zh: 愿他把杖离开我， 不使惊惶威吓我。
9.en: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;

9.zh: 我就说话，也不惧怕他， 现在我却不是那样。
9.en: then I would speak, and not fear him, for I am not so in myself.

10.zh: 我厌烦我的性命， 必由着自己述说我的哀情； 因心里苦恼，我要说话，
10.en: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

10.zh: 对　神说：不要定我有罪， 要指示我，你为何与我争辩？
10.en: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.

10.zh: 你手所造的， 你又欺压，又藐视， 却光照恶人的计谋。 这事你以为美吗？
10.en: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?

10.zh: 你的眼岂是肉眼？ 你查看岂像人查看吗？
10.en: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?

10.zh: 你的日子岂像人的日子， 你的年岁岂像人的年岁，
10.en: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,

10.zh: 就追问我的罪孽， 寻察我的罪过吗？
10.en: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?

10.zh: 其实，你知道我没有罪恶， 并没有能救[我]脱离你手的。
10.en: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.

10.zh: 你的手创造我，造就我的四肢百体， 你还要毁灭我。
10.en: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.

10.zh: 求你记念—制造我如抟泥一般， 你还要使我归于尘土吗？
10.en: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?

10.zh: 你不是倒出我来好像奶， 使我凝结如同奶饼吗？
10.en: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?

10.zh: 你以皮和肉为衣给我穿上， 用骨与筋把我全体联络。
10.en: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.

10.zh: 你将生命和慈爱赐给我； 你也眷顾保全我的心灵。
10.en: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.

10.zh: 然而，你[待我的]这些事早已藏在你心里； 我知道你久有此意。
10.en: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:

10.zh: 我若犯罪，你就察看我， 并不赦免我的罪孽。
10.en: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.

10.zh: 我若行恶，便有了祸； 我若为义，也不敢抬头， 正是满心羞愧， 眼见我的苦情。
10.en: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.

10.zh: 我若昂首自得，你就追捕我如狮子， 又在我身上显出奇能。
10.en: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.

10.zh: 你重立见证攻击我， 向我加增恼怒， 如军兵更换着攻击我。
10.en: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.

10.zh: 你为何使我出母胎呢？ 不如我当时气绝，无人得见我；
10.en: “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.

10.zh: 这样，就如没有我一般， 一出母胎就被送入坟墓。
10.en: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

10.zh: 我的日子不是甚少吗？ 求你停手宽容我， 叫我在往而不返之先— 就是往黑暗和死荫之地以先— 可以稍得畅快。
10.en: Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,
before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

10.zh: 那地甚是幽暗，是死荫混沌[之地]； 那里的光好像幽暗。
10.en: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”

11.zh: 拿玛人琐法回答说：
11.en: Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,

11.zh: 这许多的言语岂不该回答吗？ 多嘴多舌的人岂可称为义吗？
11.en: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?

11.zh: 你夸大的话岂能使人不作声吗？ 你戏笑的时候岂没有人叫你害羞吗？
11.en: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?

11.zh: 你说：我的道理纯全； 我在你眼前洁净。
11.en: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’

11.zh: 惟愿　神说话； 愿他开口攻击你，
11.en: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,

11.zh: 并将智慧的奥秘指示你； 他有诸般的智识。 所以当知道　神追讨你 比你罪孽该得的还少。
11.en: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.

11.zh: 你考察就能测透　神吗？ 你岂能尽情测透全能者吗？
11.en: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?

11.zh: 他[的智慧]高于天，你还能做什么？ 深于阴间，你还能知道什么？
11.en: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?

11.zh: 其量比地长， 比海宽。
11.en: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

11.zh: 他若经过，将人拘禁， 招人受审，谁能阻挡他呢？
11.en: If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?

11.zh: 他本知道虚妄的人； 人的罪孽，他虽不留意，还是无所不见。
11.en: For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.

11.zh: 空虚的人却毫无知识； 人生在世[好像]野驴的驹子。
11.en: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.

11.zh: 你若将心安正， 又向主举手；
11.en: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.

11.zh: 你手里若有罪孽， 就当远远地除掉， 也不容非义住在你帐棚之中。
11.en: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.

11.zh: 那时，你必仰起脸来毫无斑点； 你也必坚固，无所惧怕。
11.en: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,

11.zh: 你必忘记你的苦楚， 就是想起也如流过去的水一样。
11.en: for you will forget your misery. You will remember it like waters that have passed away.

11.zh: 你在世的日子要比正午更明， 虽有黑暗仍像早晨。
11.en: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.

11.zh: 你因有指望就必稳固， 也必[四围]巡查，坦然安息。
11.en: You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.

11.zh: 你躺卧，无人惊吓， 且有许多人向你求恩。
11.en: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.

11.zh: 但恶人的眼目必要失明。 他们无路可逃； 他们的指望就是气绝。
11.en: But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”

12.zh: 约伯回答说：
12.en: Then Job answered,

12.zh: 你们真是子民哪， 你们死亡，智慧也就灭没了。
12.en: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.

12.zh: 但我也有聪明，与你们一样， 并非不及你们。 你们所说的，谁不知道呢？
12.en: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?

12.zh: 我这求告　神、蒙他应允的人 竟成了朋友所讥笑的； 公义完全人竟受了人的讥笑。
12.en: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.

12.zh: 安逸的人心里藐视灾祸； 这灾祸常常等待滑脚的人。
12.en: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.

12.zh: 强盗的帐棚兴旺， 惹　神的人稳固， 　神[多将财物]送到他们手中。
12.en: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.

12.zh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你； 又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你；
12.en: “But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.

12.zh: 或与地说话，地必指教你； 海中的鱼也必向你说明。
12.en: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.

12.zh: 看这一切， 谁不知道是耶和华的手做成的呢？
12.en: Who doesn’t know that in all these, the LORD’s hand has done this,

12.zh: 凡活物的生命和人类的气息都在他手中。
12.en: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?

12.zh: 耳朵岂不试验言语， 正如上膛尝食物吗？
12.en: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?

12.zh: 年老的有智慧； 寿高的有知识。
12.en: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.

12.zh: 在　神有智慧和能力； 他有谋略和知识。
12.en: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.

12.zh: 他拆毁的，就不能再建造； 他捆住人，便不得开释。
12.en: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.

12.zh: 他把水留住，水便枯干； 他再发出水来，水就翻地。
12.en: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.

12.zh: 在他有能力和智慧， 被诱惑的与诱惑人的都是属他。
12.en: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.

12.zh: 他把谋士剥衣掳去， 又使审判官变成愚人。
12.en: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.

12.zh: 他放松君王的绑， 又用带子捆他们的腰。
12.en: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.

12.zh: 他把祭司剥衣掳去， 又使有能的人倾败。
12.en: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.

12.zh: 他废去忠信人的讲论， 又夺去老人的聪明。
12.en: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.

12.zh: 他使君王蒙羞被辱， 放松有力之人的腰带。
12.en: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.

12.zh: 他将深奥的事从黑暗中彰显， 使死荫显为光明。
12.en: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.

12.zh: 他使邦国兴旺而又毁灭； 他使邦国开广而又掳去。
12.en: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.

12.zh: 他将地上民中首领的聪明夺去， 使他们在荒废无路之地漂流；
12.en: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

12.zh: 他们无光，在黑暗中摸索， 又使他们东倒西歪，像醉酒的人一样。
12.en: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.

13.zh: 这一切，我眼都见过； 我耳都听过，而且明白。
13.en: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.

13.zh: 你们所知道的，我也知道， 并非不及你们。
13.en: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.

13.zh: 我真要对全能者说话； 我愿与　神理论。
13.en: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.

13.zh: 你们是编造谎言的， 都是无用的医生。
13.en: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.

13.zh: 惟愿你们全然不作声； 这就算为你们的智慧！
13.en: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.

13.zh: 请你们听我的辩论， 留心听我口中的分诉。
13.en: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.

13.zh: 你们要为　神说不义的话吗？ 为他说诡诈的言语吗？
13.en: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?

13.zh: 你们要为　神徇情吗？ 要为他争论吗？
13.en: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?

13.zh: 他查出你们来，这岂是好吗？ 人欺哄人，你们也要照样欺哄他吗？
13.en: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?

13.zh: 你们若暗中徇情， 他必要责备你们。
13.en: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.

13.zh: 他的尊荣岂不叫你们惧怕吗？ 他的惊吓岂不临到你们吗？
13.en: Won’t his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you?

13.zh: 你们以为可记念的箴言是炉灰的箴言； 你们以为可靠的坚垒是淤泥的坚垒。
13.en: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.

13.zh: 你们不要作声，任凭我吧！ 让我说话，无论如何我都承当。
13.en: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.

13.zh: 我何必把我的肉挂在牙上， 将我的命放在手中。
13.en: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?

13.zh: 他必杀我；我虽无指望， 然而我在他面前还要辩明我所行的。
13.en: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.

13.zh: 这要成为我的拯救， 因为不虔诚的人不得到他面前。
13.en: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.

13.zh: 你们要细听我的言语， 使我所辩论的入你们的耳中。
13.en: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.

13.zh: 我已陈明我的案， 知道自己有义。
13.en: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.

13.zh: 有谁与我争论， 我就情愿缄默不言，气绝而亡。
13.en: Who is he who will contend with me? For then I would hold my peace and give up the spirit.

13.zh: 惟有两件不要向我施行， 我就不躲开你的面：
13.en: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:

13.zh: 就是把你的手缩回，远离我身； 又不使你的惊惶威吓我。
13.en: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.

13.zh: 这样，你呼叫，我就回答； 或是让我说话，你回答我。
13.en: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.

13.zh: 我的罪孽和罪过有多少呢？ 求你叫我知道我的过犯与罪愆。
13.en: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.

13.zh: 你为何掩面、 拿我当仇敌呢？
13.en: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?

13.zh: 你要惊动被风吹的叶子吗？ 要追赶枯干的碎秸吗？
13.en: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?

13.zh: 你按罪状刑罚我， 又使我担当幼年的罪孽；
13.en: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.

13.zh: 也把我的脚上了木狗， 并窥察我一切的道路， 为我的脚掌划定界限。
13.en: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,

13.zh: 我已经像灭绝的烂物， 像虫蛀的衣裳。
13.en: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.

14.zh: 人为妇人所生， 日子短少，多有患难；
14.en: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.

14.zh: 出来如花，又被割下， 飞去如影，不能存留。
14.en: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.

14.zh: 这样的人你岂睁眼看他吗？ 又叫我来受审吗？
14.en: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?

14.zh: 谁能使洁净之物出于污秽之中呢？ 无论谁也不能！
14.en: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.

14.zh: 人的日子既然限定， 他的月数在你那里， 你也派定他的界限，使他不能越过，
14.en: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass.

14.zh: 便求你转眼不看他，使他得歇息， 直等他像雇工人完毕他的日子。
14.en: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.

14.zh: 树若被砍下， 还可指望发芽， 嫩枝生长不息；
14.en: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.

14.zh: 其根虽然衰老在地里， 干也死在土中，
14.en: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,

14.zh: 及至得了水气，还要发芽， 又长枝条，像新栽的树一样。
14.en: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.

14.zh: 但人死亡而消灭； 他气绝，竟在何处呢？
14.en: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?

14.zh: 海中的水绝尽， 江河消散干涸。
14.en: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,

14.zh: 人也是如此，躺下不再起来， 等到天没有了，仍不得复醒， 也不得从睡中唤醒。
14.en: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.

14.zh: 惟愿你把我藏在阴间， 存于隐密处，等你的忿怒过去； 愿你为我定了日期，记念我。
14.en: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!

14.zh: 人若死了岂能[再]活呢？ 我只要在我一切争战的日子， 等我被释放的时候来到。
14.en: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.

14.zh: 你呼叫，我便回答； 你手所做的，你必羡慕。
14.en: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.

14.zh: 但如今你数点我的脚步， 岂不窥察我的罪过吗？
14.en: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?

14.zh: 我的过犯被你封在囊中， 也缝严了我的罪孽。
14.en: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.

14.zh: 山崩变为无有； 磐石挪开原处。
14.en: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place.

14.zh: 水流消磨石头， 所流溢的洗去地上的尘土； 你也照样灭绝人的指望。
14.en: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.

14.zh: 你攻击人常常得胜，使他去世； 你改变他的容貌，叫他往而不回。
14.en: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.

14.zh: 他儿子得尊荣，他也不知道， 降为卑，他也不觉得。
14.en: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.

14.zh: 但知身上疼痛， 心中悲哀。
14.en: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”

15.zh: 提幔人以利法回答说：
15.en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

15.zh: 智慧人岂可用虚空的知识回答， 用东风充满肚腹呢？
15.en: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?

15.zh: 他岂可用无益的话 和无济于事的言语理论呢？
15.en: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?

15.zh: 你是废弃敬畏的意， 在　神面前阻止敬虔的心。
15.en: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.

15.zh: 你的罪孽指教你的口； 你选用诡诈人的舌头。
15.en: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.

15.zh: 你自己的口定你有罪，并非是我； 你自己的嘴见证你的不是。
15.en: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.

15.zh: 你岂是头一个被生的人吗？ 你受造在诸山之先吗？
15.en: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?

15.zh: 你曾听见　神的密旨吗？ 你还将智慧独自得尽吗？
15.en: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?

15.zh: 你知道什么是我们不知道的呢？ 你明白什么是我们不明白的呢？
15.en: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?

15.zh: 我们这里有白发的和年纪老迈的， 比你父亲还老。
15.en: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.

15.zh: 神用温和的话安慰你， 你以为太小吗？
15.en: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?

15.zh: 你的心为何将你逼去？ 你的眼为何冒出火星，
15.en: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,

15.zh: 使你的灵反对　神， 也任你的口发这言语？
15.en: that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?

15.zh: 人是什么，竟算为洁净呢？ 妇人所生的是什么，竟算为义呢？
15.en: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

15.zh: 神不信靠他的众圣者； 在他眼前，天也不洁净，
15.en: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;

15.zh: 何况那污秽可憎、 喝罪孽如水的世人呢！
15.en: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!

15.zh: 我指示你，你要听； 我要述说所看见的，
15.en: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare

15.zh: 就是智慧人从列祖所受， 传说而不隐瞒的。
15.en: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;

15.zh: 这地惟独赐给他们， 并没有外人从他们中间经过。
15.en: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):

15.zh: 恶人一生之日劬劳痛苦； 强暴人一生的年数也是如此。
15.en: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

15.zh: 惊吓的声音常在他耳中； 在平安时，抢夺的必临到他那里。
15.en: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.

15.zh: 他不信自己能从黑暗中转回； 他被刀剑等候。
15.en: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.

15.zh: 他漂流在外求食，[说]：哪里有食物呢？ 他知道黑暗的日子在他手边预备好了。
15.en: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

15.zh: 急难困苦叫他害怕， 而且胜了他，好像君王预备上阵一样。
15.en: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

15.zh: 他伸手攻击　神， 以骄傲攻击全能者，
15.en: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,

15.zh: 挺[着]颈项， 用盾牌的厚凸面向全能者直闯；
15.en: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,

15.zh: 是因他的脸蒙上脂油， 腰积成肥肉。
15.en: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.

15.zh: 他曾住在荒凉城邑， 无人居住、将成乱堆的房屋。
15.en: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.

15.zh: 他不得富足，财物不得常存， 产业在地上也不加增。
15.en: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.

15.zh: 他不得出离黑暗。 火焰要将他的枝子烧干； 因　神口中的气，他要灭亡 。
15.en: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.

15.zh: 他不用倚靠虚假欺哄自己， 因虚假必成为他的报应。
15.en: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.

15.zh: 他的日期未到之先，这事必成就； 他的枝子不得青绿。
15.en: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.

15.zh: 他必像葡萄树的葡萄，未熟而落； 又像橄榄树的花，一开而谢。
15.en: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.

15.zh: 原来不敬虔之辈必无生育； 受贿赂之人的帐棚必被火烧。
15.en: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.

15.zh: 他们所怀的是毒害，所生的是罪孽； 心里所预备的是诡诈。
15.en: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”

16.zh: 约伯回答说：
16.en: Then Job answered,

16.zh: 这样的话我听了许多； 你们安慰人，反叫人愁烦。
16.en: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!

16.zh: 虚空的言语有穷尽吗？ 有什么话惹动你回答呢？
16.en: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?

16.zh: 我也能说你们那样的话； 你们若处在我的境遇， 我也会联络言语攻击你们， 又能向你们摇头。
16.en: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,

16.zh: 但我必用口坚固你们， 用嘴消解[你们的忧愁]。
16.en: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.

16.zh: 我虽说话，忧愁仍不得消解； 我虽停住不说，忧愁就离开我吗？
16.en: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?

16.zh: 但现在　神使我困倦， 使亲友远离我，
16.en: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made all my company desolate.

16.zh: 又抓住我，作见证[攻击我]； 我身体的枯瘦也当面见证我的不是。
16.en: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.

16.zh: 主发怒撕裂我，逼迫我， 向我切齿； 我的敌人怒目看我。
16.en: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.

16.zh: 他们向我开口， 打我的脸羞辱我， 聚会攻击我。
16.en: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me.

16.zh: 神把我交给不敬虔的人， 把我扔到恶人的手中。
16.en: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.

16.zh: 我素来安逸，他折断我， 掐住我的颈项，把我摔碎， 又立我为他的箭靶子。
16.en: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target.

16.zh: 他的弓箭手四面围绕我； 他破裂我的肺腑，并不留情， 把我的胆倾倒在地上，
16.en: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.

16.zh: 将我破裂又破裂， 如同勇士向我直闯。
16.en: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.

16.zh: 我缝麻布在我皮肤上， 把我的角放在尘土中。
16.en: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.

16.zh: 我的脸因哭泣发紫， 在我的眼皮上有死荫。
16.en: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids,

16.zh: 我的手中却无强暴； 我的祈祷也是清洁。
16.en: although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.

16.zh: 地啊，不要遮盖我的血！ 不要[阻挡]我的哀求！
16.en: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.

16.zh: 现今，在天有我的见证， 在上有我的中保。
16.en: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.

16.zh: 我的朋友讥诮我， 我却向　神眼泪汪汪。
16.en: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,

16.zh: 愿人得与　神辩白， 如同人与朋友辩白一样；
16.en: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!

16.zh: 因为再过几年， 我必走那往而不返之路。
16.en: For when a few years have come, I will go the way of no return.

17.zh: 我的心灵消耗，我的日子灭尽； 坟墓为我[预备]好了。
17.en: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.

17.zh: 真有戏笑我的在我这里， 我眼常见他们惹动我。
17.en: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.

17.zh: 愿主拿凭据给我，自己为我作保。 [在你以外]谁肯与我击掌呢？
17.en: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?

17.zh: 因你使他们心不明理， 所以你必不高举他们。
17.en: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.

17.zh: 控告他的朋友、以朋友为可抢夺的， 连他儿女的眼睛也要失明。
17.en: He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.

17.zh: 神使我作了民中的笑谈； 他们也吐唾沫在我脸上。
17.en: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.

17.zh: 我的眼睛因忧愁昏花； 我的百体好像影儿。
17.en: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.

17.zh: 正直人因此必惊奇； 无辜的人要兴起攻击不敬虔之辈。
17.en: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.

17.zh: 然而，义人要持守所行的道； 手洁的人要力上加力。
17.en: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.

17.zh: 至于你们众人，可以再来[辩论]吧！ 你们中间，我找不着一个智慧人。
17.en: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.

17.zh: 我的日子已经过了； 我的谋算、我心所想望的已经断绝。
17.en: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.

17.zh: 他们以黑夜为白昼， [说]：亮光近乎黑暗。
17.en: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.

17.zh: 我若盼望阴间为我的房屋， 若下榻在黑暗中，
17.en: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,

17.zh: 若对朽坏说：你是我的父； 对虫说：你是我的母亲姊妹；
17.en: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’

17.zh: 这样，我的指望在哪里呢？ 我所指望的谁能看见呢？
17.en: where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it?

17.zh: 等到安息在尘土中， 这指望必下到阴间的门闩那里了。
17.en: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”

18.zh: 书亚人比勒达回答说：
18.en: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

18.zh: 你寻索言语要到几时呢？ 你可以揣摩思想，然后我们就说话。
18.en: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.

18.zh: 我们为何算为畜生， 在你眼中看作污秽呢？
18.en: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?

18.zh: 你这恼怒将自己撕裂的， 难道大地为你见弃、 磐石挪开原处吗？
18.en: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?

18.zh: 恶人的亮光必要熄灭； 他的火焰必不照耀。
18.en: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.

18.zh: 他帐棚中的亮光要变为黑暗； 他以上的灯也必熄灭。
18.en: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.

18.zh: 他坚强的脚步必见狭窄； 自己的计谋必将他绊倒。
18.en: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.

18.zh: 因为他被自己的脚陷入网中， 走在缠人的网罗上。
18.en: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.

18.zh: 圈套必抓住他的脚跟； 机关必擒获他。
18.en: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.

18.zh: 活扣为他藏在土内； 羁绊为他藏在路上。
18.en: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.

18.zh: 四面的惊吓要使他害怕， 并且追赶他的脚跟。
18.en: Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.

18.zh: 他的力量必因饥饿衰败； 祸患要在他旁边等候。
18.en: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.

18.zh: 他本身的肢体要被吞吃； 死亡的长子要吞吃他的肢体。
18.en: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.

18.zh: 他要从所倚靠的帐棚被拔出来， 带到惊吓的王那里。
18.en: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.

18.zh: 不属他的必住在他的帐棚里； 硫磺必撒在他所住之处。
18.en: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.

18.zh: 下边，他的根本要枯干； 上边，他的枝子要剪除。
18.en: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.

18.zh: 他的记念在地上必然灭亡； 他的名字在街上也不存留。
18.en: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.

18.zh: 他必从光明中被撵到黑暗里， 必被赶出世界。
18.en: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

18.zh: 在本民中必无子无孙； 在寄居之地也无一人存留。
18.en: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.

18.zh: 以后来的要惊奇他的日子， 好像以前去的受了惊骇。
18.en: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.

18.zh: 不义之人的住处总是这样； 此乃不认识　神之人的地步。
18.en: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”

19.zh: 约伯回答说：
19.en: Then Job answered,

19.zh: 你们搅扰我的心， 用言语压碎我要到几时呢？
19.en: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?

19.zh: 你们这十次羞辱我； 你们苦待我也不以为耻。
19.en: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.

19.zh: 果真我有错， 这错乃是在我。
19.en: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.

19.zh: 你们果然要向我夸大， 以我的羞辱为证指责我，
19.en: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,

19.zh: 就该知道是　神倾覆我， 用网罗围绕我。
19.en: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.

19.zh: 我因委曲呼叫，却不蒙应允； 我呼求，却不得公断。
19.en: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.

19.zh: 神用篱笆拦住我的道路，使我不得经过； 又使我的路径黑暗。
19.en: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.

19.zh: 他剥去我的荣光， 摘去我头上的冠冕。
19.en: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

19.zh: 他在四围攻击我，我便归于死亡， 将我的指望如树拔出来。
19.en: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.

19.zh: 他的忿怒向我发作， 以我为敌人。
19.en: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.

19.zh: 他的军旅一齐上来， 修筑战路攻击我， 在我帐棚的四围安营。
19.en: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.

19.zh: 他把我的弟兄隔在远处， 使我所认识的全然与我生疏。
19.en: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.

19.zh: 我的亲戚与我断绝； 我的密友都忘记我。
19.en: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.

19.zh: 在我家寄居的， 和我的使女都以我为外人； 我在他们眼中看为外邦人。
19.en: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.

19.zh: 我呼唤仆人， 虽用口求他，他还是不回答。
19.en: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.

19.zh: 我口的气味，我妻子厌恶； 我的恳求，我同胞也憎嫌。
19.en: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.

19.zh: 连小孩子也藐视我； 我若起来，他们都嘲笑我。
19.en: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.

19.zh: 我的密友都憎恶我； 我平日所爱的人向我翻脸。
19.en: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.

19.zh: 我的皮肉紧贴骨头； 我只剩牙皮逃脱了。
19.en: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

19.zh: 我朋友啊，可怜我！可怜我！ 因为　神的手攻击我。
19.en: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.

19.zh: 你们为什么仿佛　神逼迫我， 吃我的肉还以为不足呢？
19.en: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

19.zh: 惟愿我的言语现在写上， 都记录在书上；
19.en: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!

19.zh: 用铁笔镌刻， 用铅灌在磐石上，直存到永远。
19.en: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!

19.zh: 我知道我的救赎主活着， 末了必站立在地上。
19.en: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

19.zh: 我这皮肉灭绝之后， 我必在肉体之外得见　神。
19.en: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,

19.zh: 我自己要见他， 亲眼要看他，并不像外人。 我的心肠在我里面消灭了！
19.en: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.

19.zh: 你们若说：我们逼迫他要何等地重呢？ [惹]事的根乃在乎他；
19.en: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,

19.zh: 你们就当惧怕刀剑； 因为忿怒[惹动]刀剑的刑罚， 使你们知道有报应。
19.en: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”

20.zh: 拿玛人琐法回答说：
20.en: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,

20.zh: 我心中急躁， 所以我的思念叫我回答。
20.en: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.

20.zh: 我已听见那羞辱我，责备我的话； 我的悟性叫我回答。
20.en: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.

20.zh: 你岂不知亘古以来， 自从人生在地，
20.en: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,

20.zh: 恶人夸胜是暂时的， 不敬虔人的喜乐不过转眼之间吗？
20.en: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?

20.zh: 他的尊荣虽达到天上， 头虽顶到云中，
20.en: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,

20.zh: 他终必灭亡，像自己的粪一样； 素来见他的人要说：他在哪里呢？
20.en: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’

20.zh: 他必飞去如梦，不再寻见， 速被赶去，如夜间的异象。
20.en: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.

20.zh: 亲眼见过他的，必不再见他； 他的本处也再见不着他。
20.en: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.

20.zh: 他的儿女要求穷人的恩； 他的手要赔还[不义]之财。
20.en: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.

20.zh: 他的骨头虽然有青年[之力]， 却要和他一同躺卧在尘土中。
20.en: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.

20.zh: 他口内虽以恶为甘甜， 藏在舌头底下，
20.en: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,

20.zh: 爱恋不舍，含在口中；
20.en: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth,

20.zh: 他的食物在肚里却要化为酸， 在他里面成为虺蛇的恶毒。
20.en: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.

20.zh: 他吞了财宝，还要吐出； 　神要从他腹中掏出来。
20.en: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.

20.zh: 他必吸饮虺蛇的毒气； 蝮蛇的舌头也必杀他。
20.en: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.

20.zh: 流奶与蜜之河， 他不得再见。
20.en: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.

20.zh: 他劳碌得来的要赔还，不得享用； 不能照所得的财货欢乐。
20.en: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.

20.zh: 他欺压穷人，且又离弃； 强取非自己所盖的房屋 。
20.en: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.

20.zh: 他因贪而无厌， 所喜悦的连一样也不能保守。
20.en: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.

20.zh: 其余的没有一样他不吞灭， 所以他的福乐不能长久。
20.en: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure.

20.zh: 他在满足有余的时候，必到狭窄的地步； 凡受苦楚的人都必加手在他身上。
20.en: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.

20.zh: 他正要充满肚腹的时候， 　神必将猛烈的忿怒降在他身上； 正在他吃饭的时候， 要将这忿怒像雨降在他身上。
20.en: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.

20.zh: 他要躲避铁器； 铜弓[的箭]要将他射透。
20.en: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.

20.zh: 他把箭一抽，就从他身上出来； 发光的箭头从他胆中出来， 有惊惶临在他身上。
20.en: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.

20.zh: 他的财宝归于黑暗； [人]所不吹的火要把他烧灭， 要把他帐棚中所剩下的烧毁。
20.en: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.

20.zh: 天要显明他的罪孽； 地要兴起攻击他。
20.en: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.

20.zh: 他的家产必然过去； 　神发怒的日子，[他的货物]都要消灭。
20.en: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.

20.zh: 这是恶人从　神所得的分， 是　神为他所定的产业。
20.en: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”

21.zh: 约伯回答说：
21.en: Then Job answered,

21.zh: 你们要细听我的言语， 就算是你们安慰我。
21.en: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.

21.zh: 请宽容我，我又要说话； 说了以后，任凭你们嗤笑吧！
21.en: Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on.

21.zh: 我岂是向人诉冤？ 为何不焦急呢？
21.en: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?

21.zh: 你们要看着我而惊奇， 用手捂口。
21.en: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.

21.zh: 我每逢思想，心就惊惶， 浑身战兢。
21.en: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.

21.zh: 恶人为何存活， 享大寿数，势力强盛呢？
21.en: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?

21.zh: 他们眼见儿孙， 和他们一同坚立。
21.en: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.

21.zh: 他们的家宅平安无惧； 　神的杖也不加在他们身上。
21.en: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

21.zh: 他们的公牛孳生而不断绝； 母牛下犊而不掉胎。
21.en: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.

21.zh: 他们打发小孩子出去，[多]如羊群； 他们的儿女踊跃跳舞。
21.en: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.

21.zh: 他们随着琴鼓歌唱， 又因箫声欢喜。
21.en: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

21.zh: 他们度日诸事亨通， 转眼下入阴间。
21.en: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.

21.zh: 他们对　神说：离开我们吧！ 我们不愿晓得你的道。
21.en: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.

21.zh: 全能者是谁，我们何必事奉他呢？ 求告他有什么益处呢？
21.en: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’

21.zh: 看哪，他们亨通不在乎自己； 恶人所谋定的离我好远。
21.en: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

21.zh: 恶人的灯何尝熄灭？ 患难何尝临到他们呢？ 　神何尝发怒，[向他们]分散灾祸呢？
21.en: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?

21.zh: 他们何尝像风前的碎秸， 如暴风刮去的糠秕呢？
21.en: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?

21.zh: [你们说]：　神为恶人的儿女积蓄罪孽； [我说]：不如本人受报，好使他亲自知道。
21.en: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.

21.zh: 愿他亲眼看见自己败亡， 亲自饮全能者的忿怒。
21.en: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

21.zh: 他的岁月既尽， 他还顾他本家吗？
21.en: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?

21.zh: 神既审判那在高位的， 谁能将知识教训他呢？
21.en: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?

21.zh: 有人至死身体强壮， 尽得平靖安逸；
21.en: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

21.zh: 他的奶桶充满， 他的骨髓滋润。
21.en: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.

21.zh: 有人至死心中痛苦， 终身未尝福乐的滋味；
21.en: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.

21.zh: 他们一样躺卧在尘土中， 都被虫子遮盖。
21.en: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.

21.zh: 我知道你们的意思， 并诬害我的计谋。
21.en: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.

21.zh: 你们说：霸者的房屋在哪里？ 恶人住过的帐棚在哪里？
21.en: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’

21.zh: 你们岂没有询问过路的人吗？ 不知道他们所引的证据吗？
21.en: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,

21.zh: 就是恶人在祸患的日子得存留， 在发怒的日子得逃脱。
21.en: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led out to the day of wrath?

21.zh: 他所行的，有谁当面给他说明？ 他所做的，有谁报应他呢？
21.en: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?

21.zh: 然而他要被抬到茔地； 并有人看守坟墓。
21.en: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.

21.zh: 他要以谷中的土块为甘甜； 在他以先去的无数， 在他以后去的更多。
21.en: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.

21.zh: 你们对答的话中既都错谬， 怎么徒然安慰我呢？
21.en: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”

22.zh: 提幔人以利法回答说：
22.en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

22.zh: 人岂能使　神有益呢？ 智慧人但能有益于己。
22.en: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

22.zh: 你为人公义，岂叫全能者喜悦呢？ 你行为完全，岂能使他得利呢？
22.en: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?

22.zh: 岂是因你敬畏他 就责备你、审判你吗？
22.en: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?

22.zh: 你的罪恶岂不是大吗？ 你的罪孽也没有穷尽；
22.en: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.

22.zh: 因你无故强取弟兄的物为当头， 剥去贫寒人的衣服。
22.en: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

22.zh: 困乏的人，你没有给他水喝； 饥饿的人，你没有给他食物。
22.en: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.

22.zh: 有能力的人就得地土； 尊贵的人也住在其中。
22.en: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.

22.zh: 你打发寡妇空手回去， 折断孤儿的膀臂。
22.en: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

22.zh: 因此，有网罗环绕你， 有恐惧忽然使你惊惶；
22.en: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,

22.zh: 或有黑暗蒙蔽你， 并有洪水淹没你。
22.en: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.

22.zh: 神岂不是在高天吗？ 你看星宿何其高呢！
22.en: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!

22.zh: 你说：　神知道什么？ 他岂能看透幽暗施行审判呢？
22.en: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

22.zh: 密云将他遮盖，使他不能看见； 他周游穹苍。
22.en: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’

22.zh: 你要依从上古的道吗？ 这道是恶人所行的。
22.en: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,

22.zh: 他们未到死期，忽然除灭； 根基毁坏，好像被江河冲去。
22.en: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

22.zh: 他们向　神说：离开我们吧！ 又[说]：全能者能把我们怎么样呢？
22.en: who said to God, ‘Depart from us!’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’

22.zh: 哪知　神以美物充满他们的房屋； 但恶人所谋定的离我好远。
22.en: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

22.zh: 义人看见他们的[结局]就欢喜； 无辜的人嗤笑他们，
22.en: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,

22.zh: 说：那起来攻击我们的果然被剪除， 其余的都被火烧灭。
22.en: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’

22.zh: 你要认识　神，就得平安； 福气也必临到你。
22.en: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.

22.zh: 你当领受他口中的教训， 将他的言语存在心里。
22.en: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

22.zh: 你若归向全能者，从你帐棚中远除不义， 就必得建立。
22.en: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

22.zh: 要将[你的]珍宝丢在尘土里， 将俄斐的[黄金]丢在溪河石头之间；
22.en: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.

22.zh: 全能者就必为你的珍宝， 作你的宝银。
22.en: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.

22.zh: 你就要以全能者为喜乐， 向　神仰起脸来。
22.en: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.

22.zh: 你要祷告他，他就听你； 你也要还你的愿。
22.en: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.

22.zh: 你定意要做何事，必然给你成就； 亮光也必照耀你的路。
22.en: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.

22.zh: 人使[你]降卑，你仍可说：[必得]高升； 谦卑的人，　神必然拯救。
22.en: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.

22.zh: 人非无辜，　神且要搭救他； 他因你手中清洁，必蒙拯救。
22.en: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”

23.zh: 如今我的哀告还算为悖逆； 我的责罚比我的唉哼还重。
23.en: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

23.zh: 惟愿我能知道在哪里可以寻见　神， 能到他的台前，
23.en: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

23.zh: 我就在他面前将我的案件陈明， 满口辩白。
23.en: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

23.zh: 我必知道他回答我的言语， 明白他向我所说的话。
23.en: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.

23.zh: 他岂用大能与我争辩吗？ 必不这样！他必理会我。
23.en: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.

23.zh: 在他那里正直人可以与他辩论； 这样，我必永远脱离那审判我的。
23.en: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.

23.zh: 只是，我往前行，他不[在那里]， 往后退，也不能见他。
23.en: “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.

23.zh: 他在左边行事，我却不能看见， 在右边隐藏，我也不能见他。
23.en: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.

23.zh: 然而他知道我所行的路； 他试炼我之后，我必如精金。
23.en: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.

23.zh: 我脚追随他的步履； 我谨守他的道，并不偏离。
23.en: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.

23.zh: 他嘴唇的命令，我未曾背弃； 我看重他口中的言语，过于我需用的饮食。
23.en: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

23.zh: 只是他[心志]已定，谁能使他转意呢？ 他心里所愿的，就行出来。
23.en: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.

23.zh: 他向我所定的，就必做成； 这类的事他还有许多。
23.en: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.

23.zh: 所以我在他面前惊惶； 我思念[这事]便惧怕他。
23.en: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.

23.zh: 神使我丧胆； 全能者使我惊惶。
23.en: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.

23.zh: 我的恐惧不是因为黑暗， 也不是因为幽暗蒙蔽我的脸。
23.en: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.

24.zh: 全能者既定期[罚恶]， 为何不使认识他的人看见那日子呢？
24.en: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?

24.zh: 有人挪移地界， 抢夺群畜而牧养。
24.en: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.

24.zh: 他们拉去孤儿的驴， 强取寡妇的牛为当头。
24.en: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.

24.zh: 他们使穷人离开正道； 世上的贫民尽都隐藏。
24.en: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.

24.zh: 这些贫穷人如同野驴出到旷野，殷勤寻找食物； 他们[靠着]野地给儿女糊口，
24.en: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.

24.zh: 收割[别人]田间的禾稼， 摘取恶人余剩的葡萄，
24.en: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.

24.zh: 终夜赤身无衣， 天气寒冷毫无遮盖，
24.en: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.

24.zh: 在山上被大雨淋湿， 因没有避身之处就挨近磐石。
24.en: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.

24.zh: 又有人从母怀中抢夺孤儿， 强取穷人的[衣服]为当头，
24.en: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,

24.zh: 使人赤身无衣，到处流行， 且因饥饿扛抬禾捆，
24.en: so that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.

24.zh: 在那些人的围墙内造油，榨酒， 自己还口渴。
24.en: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.

24.zh: 在多民的城内有人唉哼， 受伤的人哀号； 　神却不理会[那恶人]的愚妄。
24.en: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.

24.zh: 又有人背弃光明， 不认识光明的道， 不住在光明的路上。
24.en: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.

24.zh: 杀人的黎明起来， 杀害困苦穷乏人， 夜间又作盗贼。
24.en: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.

24.zh: 奸夫等候黄昏， 说：必无眼能见我， 就把脸蒙蔽。
24.en: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ He disguises his face.

24.zh: 盗贼黑夜挖窟窿； 白日躲藏， 并不认识光明。
24.en: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.

24.zh: 他们看早晨如幽暗， 因为他们晓得幽暗的惊骇。
24.en: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.

24.zh: [这些恶人犹如浮萍]快快[飘去]。 他们所得的分在世上被咒诅； 他们不得再走葡萄园的路。
24.en: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed on the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.

24.zh: 干旱炎热消没雪水； 阴间也如此[消没]犯罪之辈。
24.en: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.

24.zh: 怀他的母要忘记他； 虫子要吃他，觉得甘甜； 他不再被人记念。 不义[的人]必如树折断。
24.en: The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree.

24.zh: 他恶待不怀孕不生养的妇人， 不善待寡妇。
24.en: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.

24.zh: 然而　神用能力保全有势力的人； 那性命难保的人仍然兴起。
24.en: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.

24.zh: 神使他们安稳，他们就有所倚靠； 　神的眼目也看顾他们的道路。
24.en: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.

24.zh: 他们被高举，不过片时就没有了； 他们降为卑，被除灭，与众人一样， 又如谷穗被割。
24.en: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.

24.zh: 若不是这样，谁能证实我是说谎的， 将我的言语驳为虚空呢？
24.en: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”

25.zh: 神有治理之权，有威严可畏； 他在高处施行和平。
25.en: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.

25.zh: 他的诸军岂能数算？ 他的光亮一发，谁不蒙照呢？
25.en: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?

25.zh: 这样在　神面前，人怎能称义？ 妇人所生的怎能洁净？
25.en: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?

25.zh: 在　神眼前，月亮也无光亮， 星宿也不清洁。
25.en: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;

25.zh: 何况如虫的人， 如蛆的世人呢！
25.en: How much less man, who is a worm, and the son of man, who is a worm!”

26.zh: 无能的人蒙你何等的帮助！ 膀臂无力的人蒙你何等的拯救！
26.en: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

26.zh: 无智慧的人蒙你何等的指教！ 你向他多显大知识！
26.en: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!

26.zh: 你向谁发出言语来？ 谁的灵从你而出？
26.en: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?

26.zh: 在大水和水族以下的阴魂战兢。
26.en: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

26.zh: 在　神面前，阴间显露； 灭亡也不得遮掩。
26.en: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

26.zh: 神将北极铺在空中， 将大地悬在虚空；
26.en: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.

26.zh: 将水包在密云中， 云却不破裂；
26.en: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.

26.zh: 遮蔽他的宝座， 将云铺在其上；
26.en: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.

26.zh: 在水面的周围划出界限， 直到光明黑暗的交界。
26.en: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.

26.zh: 天的柱子因他的斥责震动惊奇。
26.en: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

26.zh: 他以能力搅动大海； 他借知识打伤拉哈伯，
26.en: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.

26.zh: 借他的灵使天有妆饰； 他的手刺杀快蛇。
26.en: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

26.zh: 看哪，这不过是　神工作的些微； 我们所听于他的是何等细微的声音！ 他大能的雷声谁能明透呢？
26.en: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”

27.zh: 约伯接着说：
27.en: Job again took up his parable, and said,

27.zh: 神夺去我的理，全能者使我心中愁苦。 我指着永生的　神起誓：
27.en: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter

27.zh: 我的生命尚在我里面； 　神所赐呼吸之气仍在我的鼻孔内。
27.en: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

27.zh: 我的嘴决不说非义之言； 我的舌也不说诡诈之语。
27.en: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.

27.zh: 我断不以你们为是； 我至死必不以自己为不正！
27.en: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

27.zh: 我持定我的义，必不放松； 在世的日子，我心必不责备我。
27.en: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.

27.zh: 愿我的仇敌如恶人一样； 愿那起来攻击我的，如不义之人一般。
27.en: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.

27.zh: 不敬虔的人虽然得利， 　神夺取其命的时候还有什么指望呢？
27.en: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

27.zh: 患难临到他， 　神岂能听他的呼求？
27.en: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

27.zh: 他岂以全能者为乐， 随时求告　神呢？
27.en: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?

27.zh: 神的作为，我要指教你们； 全能者所行的，我也不隐瞒。
27.en: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.

27.zh: 你们自己也都见过， 为何全然变为虚妄呢？
27.en: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?

27.zh: 神为恶人所定的分， 强暴人从全能者所得的报乃是这样：
27.en: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

27.zh: 倘或他的儿女增多，还是被刀所杀； 他的子孙必不得饱食。
27.en: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.

27.zh: 他所遗留的人必死而埋葬； 他的寡妇也不哀哭。
27.en: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.

27.zh: 他虽积蓄银子如尘沙， 预备衣服如泥土；
27.en: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

27.zh: 他只管预备，义人却要穿上； 他的银子，无辜的人要分取。
27.en: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.

27.zh: 他建造房屋如虫做窝， 又如守望者所搭的棚。
27.en: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.

27.zh: 他虽富足躺卧，却不得收殓， 转眼之间就不在了。
27.en: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.

27.zh: 惊恐如波涛将他追上； 暴风在夜间将他刮去。
27.en: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.

27.zh: 东风把他飘去， 又刮他离开本处。
27.en: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.

27.zh: 神要向他射箭，并不留情； 他恨不得逃脱　神的手。
27.en: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.

27.zh: 人要向他拍掌， 并要发叱声，使他离开本处。
27.en: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.

28.zh: 银子有矿； 炼金有方。
28.en: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.

28.zh: 铁从地里挖出； 铜从石中熔化。
28.en: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

28.zh: 人为黑暗定界限， 查究幽暗阴翳的石头，直到极处，
28.en: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.
