28.zh: 在无人居住之处刨开矿穴， [过路的人]也想不到他们； 又与人远离，悬在空中摇来摇去。
28.en: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.

28.zh: 至于地，能出粮食， 地内好像被火翻起来。
28.en: As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

28.zh: 地中的石头有蓝宝石， 并有金沙。
28.en: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.

28.zh: 矿中的路鸷鸟不得知道； 鹰眼也未见过。
28.en: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.

28.zh: 狂傲的野兽未曾行过； 猛烈的狮子也未曾经过。
28.en: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

28.zh: 人伸手凿开坚石， 倾倒山根，
28.en: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.

28.zh: 在磐石中凿出水道， 亲眼看见各样宝物。
28.en: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.

28.zh: 他封闭水不得滴流， 使隐藏的物显露出来。
28.en: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.

28.zh: 然而，智慧有何处可寻？ 聪明之处在哪里呢？
28.en: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?

28.zh: 智慧的价值无人能知， 在活人之地也无处可寻。
28.en: Man doesn’t know its price, and it isn’t found in the land of the living.

28.zh: 深渊说：不在我内； 沧海说：不在我中。
28.en: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’

28.zh: 智慧非用黄金可得， 也不能平白银为它的价值。
28.en: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.

28.zh: 俄斐金和贵重的红玛瑙， 并蓝宝石，不足与较量；
28.en: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

28.zh: 黄金和玻璃不足与比较； 精金的器皿不足与兑换。
28.en: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

28.zh: 珊瑚、水晶都不足论； 智慧的价值胜过珍珠。
28.en: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

28.zh: 古实的红璧玺不足与比较； 精金也不足与较量。
28.en: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won’t be valued with pure gold.

28.zh: 智慧从何处来呢？ 聪明之处在哪里呢？
28.en: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?

28.zh: 是向一切有生命的眼目隐藏， 向空中的飞鸟掩蔽。
28.en: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

28.zh: 灭没和死亡说： 我们风闻其名。
28.en: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’

28.zh: 神明白智慧的道路， 晓得智慧的所在。
28.en: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.

28.zh: 因他鉴察直到地极， 遍观普天之下，
28.en: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.

28.zh: 要为风定轻重， 又度量诸水；
28.en: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.

28.zh: 他为雨露定命令， 为雷电定道路。
28.en: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,

28.zh: 那时他看见智慧，而且述说； 他坚定，并且查究。
28.en: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.

28.zh: 他对人说：敬畏主就是智慧； 远离恶便是聪明。
28.en: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”

29.zh: 约伯又接着说：
29.en: Job again took up his parable, and said,

29.zh: 惟愿我[的景况]如从前的月份， 如　神保守我的日子。
29.en: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;

29.zh: 那时他的灯照在我头上； 我借他的光行过黑暗。
29.en: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

29.zh: 我愿如壮年的时候： 那时我在帐棚中， 　神待我有密友之情；
29.en: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,

29.zh: 全能者仍与我同在； 我的儿女都环绕我。
29.en: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

29.zh: 奶多可洗我的脚； 磐石为我出油成河。
29.en: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,

29.zh: 我出到城门， 在街上设立座位；
29.en: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

29.zh: 少年人见我而回避， 老年人也起身站立；
29.en: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.

29.zh: 王子都停止说话， 用手捂口；
29.en: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

29.zh: 首领静默无声， 舌头贴住上膛。
29.en: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

29.zh: 耳朵听我的，就称我有福； 眼睛看我的，便称赞我；
29.en: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me,

29.zh: 因我拯救哀求的困苦人 和无人帮助的孤儿。
29.en: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,

29.zh: 将要灭亡的为我祝福； 我也使寡妇心中欢乐。
29.en: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

29.zh: 我以公义为衣服， 以公平为外袍和冠冕。
29.en: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

29.zh: 我为瞎子的眼， 瘸子的脚。
29.en: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.

29.zh: 我为穷乏人的父； 素不认识的人，我查明他的案件。
29.en: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn’t know.

29.zh: 我打破不义之人的牙床， 从他牙齿中夺了所抢的。
29.en: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

29.zh: 我便说：我必死在家中， 必增添我的日子，多如尘沙。
29.en: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.

29.zh: 我的根长到水边； 露水终夜沾在我的枝上。
29.en: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.

29.zh: 我的荣耀在身上增新； 我的弓在手中日强。
29.en: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’

29.zh: 人听见我而仰望， 静默等候我的指教。
29.en: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.

29.zh: 我说话之后，他们就不再说； 我的言语[像雨露]滴在他们身上。
29.en: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.

29.zh: 他们仰望我如仰望雨， 又张开口如切慕春雨。
29.en: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.

29.zh: 他们不敢自信，我就向他们含笑； 他们不使我脸上的光改变。
29.en: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.

29.zh: 我为他们选择道路，又坐首位； 我如君王在军队中居住， 又如吊丧的安慰伤心的人。
29.en: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.

30.zh: 但如今，比我年少的人戏笑我； 其人之父我曾藐视， 不肯安在看守我羊群的狗中。
30.en: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.

30.zh: 他们壮年的气力既已衰败， 其手之力与我何益呢？
30.en: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?

30.zh: 他们因穷乏饥饿，身体枯瘦， 在荒废凄凉的幽暗中啃干燥之地，
30.en: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.

30.zh: 在草丛之中采咸草， 罗腾的根为他们的食物。
30.en: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.

30.zh: 他们从人中被赶出； 人追喊他们如贼一般，
30.en: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief,

30.zh: 以致他们住在荒谷之间， 在地洞和岩穴中；
30.en: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

30.zh: 在草丛中叫唤， 在荆棘下聚集。
30.en: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.

30.zh: 这都是愚顽下贱人的儿女； 他们被鞭打，赶出境外。
30.en: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.

30.zh: 现在这些人以我为歌曲， 以我为笑谈。
30.en: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.

30.zh: 他们厌恶我，躲在旁边站着， 不住地吐唾沫在我脸上。
30.en: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.

30.zh: 松开他们的绳索苦待我， 在我面前脱去辔头。
30.en: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.

30.zh: 这等下流人在我右边起来， 推开我的脚，筑成战路来攻击我。
30.en: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me.

30.zh: 这些无人帮助的， 毁坏我的道，加增我的灾。
30.en: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.

30.zh: 他们来如同闯进大破口， 在毁坏之间滚[在我身上]。
30.en: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.

30.zh: 惊恐临到我， 驱逐我的尊荣如风； 我的福禄如云过去。
30.en: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.

30.zh: 现在我心极其悲伤； 困苦的日子将我抓住。
30.en: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.

30.zh: 夜间，我里面的骨头刺我， [疼痛]不止，好像啃我。
30.en: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.

30.zh: 因　[神]的大力，我的外衣污秽不堪， 又如里衣的领子将我缠住。
30.en: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.

30.zh: 神把我扔在淤泥中， 我就像尘土和炉灰一般。
30.en: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.

30.zh: [主啊]，我呼求你，你不应允我； 我站起来，你就定睛看我。
30.en: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.

30.zh: 你向我变心，待我残忍， 又用大能追逼我，
30.en: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.

30.zh: 把我提在风中，使我驾风而行， 又使我消灭在烈风中。
30.en: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.

30.zh: 我知道要使我临到死地， 到那为众生所定的阴宅。
30.en: For I know that you will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living.

30.zh: 然而，人仆倒岂不伸手？ 遇灾难岂不求救呢？
30.en: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

30.zh: 人遭难，我岂不为他哭泣呢？ 人穷乏，我岂不为他忧愁呢？
30.en: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?

30.zh: 我仰望得好处，灾祸就到了； 我等待光明，黑暗便来了。
30.en: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.

30.zh: 我心里烦扰不安， 困苦的日子临到我身。
30.en: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.

30.zh: 我没有日光就哀哭行去 ； 我在会中站着求救。
30.en: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

30.zh: 我与野狗为弟兄， 与鸵鸟为同伴。
30.en: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

30.zh: 我的皮肤黑[而脱落]； 我的骨头因热烧焦。
30.en: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.

30.zh: 所以，我的琴音[变]为悲音； 我的箫声[变]为哭声。
30.en: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.

31.zh: 我与眼睛立约， 怎能恋恋瞻望处女呢？
31.en: “I made a covenant with my eyes; how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?

31.zh: 从至上的　神所得之分， 从至高全能者所得之业是什么呢？
31.en: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?

31.zh: 岂不是祸患临到不义的， 灾害临到作孽的呢？
31.en: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?

31.zh: 神岂不是察看我的道路， 数点我的脚步呢？
31.en: Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?

31.zh: 我若与虚谎同行， 脚若追随诡诈； （
31.en: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit

31.zh: 我若被公道的天平称度， 使　神可以知道我的纯正；）
31.en: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);

31.zh: 我的脚步若偏离正路， 我的心若随着我的眼目， 若有玷污粘在我手上；
31.en: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,

31.zh: 就愿我所种的有别人吃， 我田所产的被拔出来。
31.en: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

31.zh: 我若受迷惑，向妇人[起淫念]， 在邻舍的门外蹲伏，
31.en: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,

31.zh: 就愿我的妻子给别人推磨， 别人也与她同室。
31.en: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.

31.zh: 因为这是大罪， 是审判官[当罚的]罪孽。
31.en: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges,

31.zh: 这本是火焚烧，直到毁灭， 必拔除我所有的家产。
31.en: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.

31.zh: 我的仆婢与我争辩的时候， 我若藐视不听他们的情节；
31.en: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,

31.zh: 神兴起，我怎样行呢？ 他察问，我怎样回答呢？
31.en: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him?

31.zh: 造我在腹中的，不也是造他吗？ 将他与我抟在腹中的岂不是一位吗？
31.en: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?

31.zh: 我若不容贫寒人得其所愿， 或叫寡妇眼中失望，
31.en: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

31.zh: 或独自吃我一点食物， 孤儿没有与我同吃； （
31.en: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it

31.zh: 从幼年时孤儿与我同长，好像父子一样； 我从出母腹就扶助寡妇。）
31.en: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, I have guided her from my mother’s womb);

31.zh: 我若见人因无衣死亡， 或见穷乏人身无遮盖；
31.en: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;

31.zh: 我若不使他因我羊的毛得暖， 为我祝福；
31.en: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;

31.zh: 我若在城门口见有帮助我的， 举手攻击孤儿；
31.en: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate;

31.zh: 情愿我的肩头从缺盆骨脱落， 我的膀臂从羊矢骨折断。
31.en: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.

31.zh: 因　神降的灾祸使我恐惧； 因他的威严，我不能妄为。
31.en: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.

31.zh: 我若以黄金为指望， 对精金说：[你是]我的倚靠；
31.en: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’

31.zh: 我若因财物丰裕， 因我手多得资财而欢喜；
31.en: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;

31.zh: 我若见太阳发光， 明月行在空中，
31.en: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,

31.zh: 心就暗暗被引诱， 口便亲手；
31.en: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth;

31.zh: 这也是审判官[当罚的]罪孽， 又是我背弃在上的　神。
31.en: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I would have denied the God who is above.

31.zh: 我若见恨我的遭报就欢喜， 见他遭灾便高兴； （
31.en: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him

31.zh: 我没有容口犯罪， 咒诅他的生命；）
31.en: (I have certainly not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);

31.zh: 若我帐棚的人未尝说， 谁不以主人的食物吃饱呢？ （
31.en: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’

31.zh: 从来我没有容客旅在街上住宿， 却开门迎接行路的人；）
31.en: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);

31.zh: 我若像亚当遮掩我的过犯， 将罪孽藏在怀中；
31.en: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,

31.zh: 因惧怕大众， 又因宗族藐视我使我惊恐， 以致闭口无言，杜门不出；
31.en: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—

31.zh: 惟愿有一位肯听我！ （看哪，在这里有我所划的押， 愿全能者回答我！）
31.en: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!

31.zh: 愿那敌我者所写的状词[在我这里]！ 我必带在肩上，又绑在头上为冠冕。
31.en: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, and I would bind it to me as a crown.

31.zh: 我必向他述说我脚步的数目， 必如君王进到他面前。
31.en: I would declare to him the number of my steps. I would go near to him like a prince.

31.zh: 我若[夺取]田地，这地向我喊冤， 犁沟一同哭泣；
31.en: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;

31.zh: 我若吃地的出产不给价值， 或叫原主丧命；
31.en: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,

31.zh: 愿这地长蒺藜代替麦子， 长恶草代替大麦。 约伯的话说完了。
31.en: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.

32.zh: 于是这三个人，因约伯自以为义就不再回答他。
32.en: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

32.zh: 那时有布西人兰族巴拉迦的儿子以利户向约伯发怒；因约伯自以为义，不以　神为义。
32.en: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.

32.zh: 他又向约伯的三个朋友发怒；因为他们想不出回答的话来，仍以约伯为有罪。
32.en: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

32.zh: 以利户要与约伯说话，就等候他们，因为他们比自己年老。
32.en: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.

32.zh: 以利户见这三个人口中无话回答，就怒气发作。
32.en: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

32.zh: 布西人巴拉迦的儿子以利户回答说： 我年轻，你们老迈； 因此我退让，不敢向你们陈说我的意见。
32.en: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old. Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.

32.zh: 我说，年老的当先说话； 寿高的当以智慧教训人。
32.en: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’

32.zh: 但在人里面有灵； 全能者的气使人有聪明。
32.en: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.

32.zh: 尊贵的不都有智慧； 寿高的不都能明白公平。
32.en: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.

32.zh: 因此我说：你们要听我言； 我也要陈说我的意见。
32.en: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’

32.zh: 你们查究所要说的话； 那时我等候你们的话， 侧耳听你们的辩论，
32.en: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.

32.zh: 留心听你们； 谁知你们中间无一人折服约伯， 驳倒他的话。
32.en: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.

32.zh: 你们切不可说：我们寻得智慧； 　神能胜他，人却不能。
32.en: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’

32.zh: 约伯没有向我争辩； 我也不用你们的话回答他。
32.en: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.

32.zh: 他们惊奇不再回答， 一言不发。
32.en: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.

32.zh: 我岂因他们不说话， 站住不再回答，仍旧等候呢？
32.en: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?

32.zh: 我也要回答我的一分话， 陈说我的意见。
32.en: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.

32.zh: 因为我的言语满怀； 我里面的灵激动我。
32.en: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.

32.zh: 我的胸怀如盛酒[之囊]没有出气之缝， 又如新皮袋快要破裂。
32.en: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.

32.zh: 我要说话，使我舒畅； 我要开口回答。
32.en: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.

32.zh: 我必不看人的情面， 也不奉承人。
32.en: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.

32.zh: 我不晓得奉承； [若奉承]，造我的主必快快除灭我。
32.en: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.

33.zh: 约伯啊，请听我的话， 留心听我一切的言语。
33.en: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.

33.zh: 我现在开口， 用舌发言。
33.en: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.

33.zh: 我的言语[要发明]心中所存的正直； 我所知道的，我嘴唇要诚实地说出。
33.en: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.

33.zh: 神的灵造我； 全能者的气使我得生。
33.en: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

33.zh: 你若回答我， 就站起来，在我面前陈明。
33.en: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.

33.zh: 我在　神面前与你一样， 也是用土造成。
33.en: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.

33.zh: 我不用威严惊吓你， 也不用势力重压你。
33.en: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.

33.zh: 你所说的，我听见了， 也听见你的言语，[说]：
33.en: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,

33.zh: 我是清洁无过的，我是无辜的； 在我里面也没有罪孽。
33.en: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.

33.zh: 神找机会攻击我， 以我为仇敌，
33.en: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.

33.zh: 把我的脚上了木狗， 窥察我一切的道路。
33.en: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’

33.zh: 我要回答你说：你这话无理， 因　神比世人更大。
33.en: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.

33.zh: 你为何与他争论呢？ 因他的事都不对人解说？
33.en: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?

33.zh: 神说一次、两次， [世人]却不理会。
33.en: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.

33.zh: 人躺在床上沉睡的时候， 　神就用梦和夜间的异象，
33.en: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed,

33.zh: 开通他们的耳朵， 将当受的教训印在他们心上，
33.en: then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,

33.zh: 好叫人不从自己的谋算， 不行骄傲的事，
33.en: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

33.zh: 拦阻人不陷于坑里， 不死在刀下。
33.en: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

33.zh: 人在床上被惩治， 骨头中不住地疼痛，
33.en: “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,

33.zh: 以致他的口厌弃食物， 心厌恶美味。
33.en: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.

33.zh: 他的肉消瘦，不得再见； 先前不见的骨头都凸出来。
33.en: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.

33.zh: 他的灵魂临近深坑； 他的生命近于灭命的。
33.en: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

33.zh: 一千天使中， 若有一个作传话的与　神同在， 指示人所当行的事，
33.en: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him,

33.zh: 神就给他开恩， 说：救赎他免得下坑； 我已经得了赎价。
33.en: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’

33.zh: 他的肉要比孩童的肉更嫩； 他就返老还童。
33.en: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.

33.zh: 他祷告　神， 　神就喜悦他， 使他欢呼朝见　神的面； 　神又看他为义。
33.en: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.

33.zh: 他在人前歌唱说： 我犯了罪，颠倒是非， 这竟与我无益。
33.en: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.

33.zh: 神救赎我的灵魂免入深坑； 我的生命也必见光。
33.en: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’

33.zh: 神两次、三次向人行这一切的事，
33.en: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,

33.zh: 为要从深坑救回人的灵魂， 使他被光照耀，与活人一样。
33.en: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

33.zh: 约伯啊，你当侧耳听我的话， 不要作声，等我讲说。
33.en: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.

33.zh: 你若有话说，就可以回答我； 你只管说，因我愿以你为是。
33.en: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.

33.zh: 若不然，你就听我说； 你不要作声，我便将智慧教训你。
33.en: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”

34.zh: 以利户又说：
34.en: Moreover Elihu answered,

34.zh: 你们智慧人要听我的话； 有知识的人要留心听我说。
34.en: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.

34.zh: 因为耳朵试验话语， 好像上膛尝食物。
34.en: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.

34.zh: 我们当选择何为是， 彼此知道何为善。
34.en: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.

34.zh: 约伯曾说：我是公义， 　神夺去我的理；
34.en: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right.

34.zh: 我虽有理，还[算为]说谎言的； 我虽无过，受的伤还不能医治。
34.en: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’

34.zh: 谁像约伯， 喝讥诮如同喝水呢？
34.en: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,

34.zh: 他与作孽的结伴， 和恶人同行。
34.en: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?

34.zh: 他说：人以　神为乐， 总是无益。
34.en: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’

34.zh: 所以，你们明理的人要听我的话。 　神断不致行恶； 全能者断不致作孽。
34.en: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

34.zh: 他必按人所做的报应人， 使各人照所行的得报。
34.en: For the work of a man he will give to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

34.zh: 神必不作恶； 全能者也不偏离公平。
34.en: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

34.zh: 谁派他治理地， 安定全世界呢？
34.en: Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?

34.zh: 他若专心为己， 将灵和气收归自己，
34.en: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,

34.zh: 凡有血气的就必一同死亡； 世人必仍归尘土。
34.en: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.

34.zh: 你若明理，就当听我的话， 留心听我言语的声音。
34.en: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.

34.zh: 难道恨恶公平的可以掌权吗？ 那有公义的、有大能的，岂可定他有罪吗？
34.en: Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty,

34.zh: 他对君王说：[你是]鄙陋的； 对贵臣说：[你是]邪恶的。
34.en: who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?

34.zh: 他待王子不徇情面， 也不看重富足的过于贫穷的， 因为都是他手所造。
34.en: He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor, for they all are the work of his hands.

34.zh: 在转眼之间，半夜之中， 他们就死亡。 百姓被震动而去世； 有权力的被夺去非借人手。
34.en: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.

34.zh: 神注目观看人的道路， 看明人的脚步。
34.en: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.

34.zh: 没有黑暗、阴翳能给作孽的藏身。
34.en: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

34.zh: 神审判人，不必使人到他面前再三鉴察。
34.en: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.

34.zh: 他用难测之法打破有能力的人， 设立别人代替他们。
34.en: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.

34.zh: 他原知道他们的行为， 使他们在夜间倾倒灭亡。
34.en: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

34.zh: 他在众人眼前击打他们， 如同击打恶人一样。
34.en: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

34.zh: 因为他们偏行不跟从他， 也不留心他的道，
34.en: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,

34.zh: 甚至使贫穷人的哀声达到他那里； 他也听了困苦人的哀声。
34.en: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.

34.zh: 他使人安静，谁能扰乱呢？ 他掩面，谁能见他呢？ 无论待一国或一人都是如此—
34.en: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,

34.zh: 使不虔敬的人不得作王， 免得有人牢笼百姓。
34.en: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.

34.zh: 有谁对　神说： 我受了[责罚]，不再犯罪；
34.en: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.

34.zh: 我所看不明的，求你指教我； 我若作了孽，必不再作？
34.en: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?

34.zh: 他施行报应， 岂要随你的心愿、叫你推辞不受吗？ 选定的是你，不是我。 你所知道的只管说吧！
34.en: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.

34.zh: 明理的人和听我话的智慧人必对我说：
34.en: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:

34.zh: 约伯说话没有知识， 言语中毫无智慧。
34.en: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’

34.zh: 愿约伯被试验到底， 因他回答像恶人一样。
34.en: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.

34.zh: 他在罪上又加悖逆； 在我们中间拍手， 用许多言语轻慢　神。
34.en: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”

35.zh: 你以为有理， 或以为你的公义胜于　神的公义，
35.en: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’

35.zh: 才说这与我有什么益处？ [我不犯罪]比犯罪有什么好处呢？
35.en: that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’

35.zh: 我要回答你和在你这里的朋友。
35.en: I will answer you, and your companions with you.

35.zh: 你要向天观看， 瞻望那高于你的穹苍。
35.en: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.

35.zh: 你若犯罪，能使　神受何害呢？ 你的过犯加增，能使　神受何损呢？
35.en: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?

35.zh: 你若是公义，还能加增他什么呢？ 他从你手里还接受什么呢？
35.en: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?

35.zh: 你的过恶[或能害]你这类的人； 你的公义[或能叫]世人[得益处]。
35.en: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.

35.zh: 人因多受欺压就哀求， 因受能者的辖制便求救，
35.en: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

35.zh: 却无人说：造我的　神在哪里？ 他使人夜间歌唱，
35.en: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,

35.zh: 教训我们胜于地上的走兽， 使我们有聪明胜于空中的飞鸟。
35.en: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’

35.zh: 他们在那里， 因恶人的骄傲呼求，却无人答应。
35.en: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.

35.zh: 虚妄的[呼求]，　神必不垂听； 全能者也必不眷顾。
35.en: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.

35.zh: 何况你说，你不得见他； 你的案件在他面前，你等候他吧。
35.en: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!

35.zh: 但如今因他未曾发怒降罚， 也不甚理会狂傲，
35.en: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance,

35.zh: 所以约伯开口说虚妄的话， 多发无知识的言语。
35.en: therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”

36.zh: 以利户又接着说：
36.en: Elihu also continued, and said,

36.zh: 你再容我片时，我就指示你， 因我还有话为　神说。
36.en: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.

36.zh: 我要将所知道的从远处引来， 将公义归给造我的主。
36.en: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

36.zh: 我的言语真不虚谎； 有知识全备的与你同在。
36.en: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.

36.zh: 神有大能，并不藐视人； 他的智慧甚广。
36.en: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.

36.zh: 他不保护恶人的性命， 却为困苦人伸冤。
36.en: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.

36.zh: 他时常看顾义人， 使他们和君王同坐宝座， 永远要被高举。
36.en: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.

36.zh: 他们若被锁链捆住， 被苦难的绳索缠住，
36.en: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,

36.zh: 他就把他们的作为和过犯指示他们， 叫他们知道有骄傲的行动。
36.en: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

36.zh: 他也开通他们的耳朵得受教训， 吩咐他们离开罪孽转回。
36.en: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.

36.zh: 他们若听从事奉他， 就必度日亨通，历年福乐；
36.en: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

36.zh: 若不听从， 就要被刀杀灭，无知无识而死。
36.en: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.

36.zh: 那心中不敬虔的人积蓄怒气； 　神捆绑他们，他们竟不求救；
36.en: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.

36.zh: 必在青年时死亡， 与污秽人一样[丧命]。
36.en: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.

36.zh: 神借着困苦救拔困苦人， 趁他们受欺压开通他们的耳朵。
36.en: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.

36.zh: 神也必引你出离患难， 进入宽阔不狭窄之地； 摆在你席上的必满有肥甘。
36.en: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.

36.zh: 但你满口有恶人批评的言语； 判断和刑罚抓住你。
36.en: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.

36.zh: 不可容忿怒触动你，使你不服责罚； 也不可因赎价大就偏行。
36.en: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.

36.zh: 你的呼求，或是你一切的势力， 果有灵验，叫你不受患难吗？
36.en: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?

36.zh: 不要切慕黑夜， 就是众民在本处被除灭的时候。
36.en: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.

36.zh: 你要谨慎，不可重看罪孽， 因你选择罪孽过于选择苦难。
36.en: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.

36.zh: 神行事有高大的能力； 教训人的有谁像他呢？
36.en: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

36.zh: 谁派定他的道路？ 谁能说：你所行的不义？
36.en: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?

36.zh: 你不可忘记称赞他所行的为大， 就是人所歌颂的。
36.en: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.

36.zh: 他所行的，万人都看见； 世人也从远处观看。
36.en: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.

36.zh: 神为大，我们不能全知； 他的年数不能测度。
36.en: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.

36.zh: 他吸取水点， 这水点从云雾中就变成雨；
36.en: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,

36.zh: 云彩将雨落下，沛然降与世人。
36.en: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.

36.zh: 谁能明白云彩如何铺张， 和　神行宫的雷声呢？
36.en: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion?

36.zh: 他将亮光普照在自己的四围； 他又遮覆海底。
36.en: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.

36.zh: 他用这些审判众民， 且赐丰富的粮食。
36.en: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.

36.zh: 他以电光遮手， 命闪电击中敌人。
36.en: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.

36.zh: 所发的雷声显明他的[作为]， 又向牲畜指明要起[暴风]。
36.en: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up.

37.zh: 因此我心战兢， 从原处移动。
37.en: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.

37.zh: 听啊，　神轰轰的声音 是他口中所发的响声。
37.en: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.

37.zh: 他发响声震遍天下， 发电光闪到地极。
37.en: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.

37.zh: 随后人听见有雷声轰轰，大发威严， 雷电接连不断。
37.en: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.

37.zh: 神发出奇妙的雷声； 他行大事，我们不能测透。
37.en: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.

37.zh: 他对雪说：要降在地上； 对大雨和暴雨也是这样说。
37.en: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.

37.zh: 他封住各人的手， 叫所造的万人都晓得他的作为。
37.en: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.

37.zh: 百兽进入穴中， 卧在洞内。
37.en: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.

37.zh: 暴风出于[南]宫； 寒冷出于北方。
37.en: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.

37.zh: 神嘘气成冰； 宽阔之水也都凝结。
37.en: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.

37.zh: 他使密云盛满水气， 布散电光之云；
37.en: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.

37.zh: 这云是借他的指引游行旋转， 得以在全地面上行他一切所吩咐的，
37.en: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,

37.zh: 或为责罚，或为[润]地， 或为施行慈爱。
37.en: whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.

37.zh: 约伯啊，你要留心听， 要站立思想　神奇妙的作为。
37.en: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

37.zh: 神如何[吩咐]这些， 如何使云中的电光照耀，你知道吗？
37.en: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?

37.zh: 云彩如何浮于空中， 那知识全备者奇妙的作为，你知道吗？
37.en: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

37.zh: 南[风]使地寂静， 你的衣服就如火热，你知道吗？
37.en: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

37.zh: 你岂能与　神同铺穹苍吗？ 这穹苍坚硬，如同铸成的镜子。
37.en: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?

37.zh: 我们愚昧不能陈说； 请你指教我们该对他说什么话。
37.en: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.

37.zh: 人岂可说：我愿与他说话？ 岂有人自愿灭亡吗？
37.en: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

37.zh: 现在[有云遮蔽]，人不得见穹苍的光亮； 但风吹过，天又发晴。
37.en: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.

37.zh: 金光出于北方， 在　神那里有可怕的威严。
37.en: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.

37.zh: 论到全能者，我们不能测度； 他大有能力，有公平和大义， 必不苦待人。
37.en: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.

37.zh: 所以，人敬畏他； 凡自[以为]心中有智慧的人，他都不顾念。
37.en: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”

38.zh: 那时，耶和华从旋风中回答约伯说：
38.en: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind,

38.zh: 谁用无知的言语使[我的]旨意暗昧不明？
38.en: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?

38.zh: 你要如勇士束腰； 我问你，你可以指示我。
38.en: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!

38.zh: 我立大地根基的时候，你在哪里呢？ 你若有聪明，只管说吧！
38.en: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.

38.zh: 你若晓得[就说]，是谁定地的尺度？ 是谁把准绳拉在其上？
38.en: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?

38.zh: 地的根基安置在何处？ 地的角石是谁安放的？
38.en: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,

38.zh: 那时，晨星一同歌唱； 　神的众子也都欢呼。
38.en: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

38.zh: 海水冲出，如出胎胞， 那时谁将它关闭呢？
38.en: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,

38.zh: 是我用云彩当海的衣服， 用幽暗当包裹它的布，
38.en: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,

38.zh: 为它定界限， 又安门和闩，
38.en: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,

38.zh: 说：你只可到这里，不可越过； 你狂傲的浪要到此止住。
38.en: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?

38.zh: 你自生以来，曾命定晨光， 使清晨的日光知道本位，
38.en: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,

38.zh: 叫这光普照地的四极， 将恶人从其中驱逐出来吗？
38.en: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?

38.zh: 因[这光]，地面改变如泥上印印， [万物]出现如衣服一样。
38.en: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.

38.zh: 亮光不照恶人； 强横的膀臂也必折断。
38.en: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.

38.zh: 你曾进到海源， 或在深渊的隐密处行走吗？
38.en: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?

38.zh: 死亡的门曾向你显露吗？ 死荫的门你曾见过吗？
38.en: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?

38.zh: 地的广大你能明透吗？ 你若全知道，只管说吧！
38.en: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.

38.zh: 光明的居所从何而至？ 黑暗的本位在于何处？
38.en: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,

38.zh: 你能带到本境， 能看明其室之路吗？
38.en: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?

38.zh: 你总知道， 因为你早已生在世上， 你日子的数目也多。
38.en: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!

38.zh: 你曾进入雪库， 或见过雹仓吗？
38.en: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,

38.zh: 这雪雹乃是我为降灾， 并打仗和争战的日子所预备的。
38.en: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

38.zh: 光亮从何路分开？ 东风从何路分散遍地？
38.en: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?

38.zh: 谁为雨水分道？ 谁为雷电开路？
38.en: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm,

38.zh: 使雨降在无人之地、 无人居住的旷野？
38.en: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,

38.zh: 使荒废凄凉[之地]得以丰足， 青草得以发生？
38.en: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?

38.zh: 雨有父吗？ 露水珠是谁生的呢？
38.en: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?

38.zh: 冰出于谁的胎？ 天上的霜是谁生的呢？
38.en: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?

38.zh: 诸水坚硬如石头； 深渊之面凝结成冰。
38.en: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.

38.zh: 你能系住昴星的结吗？ 能解开参星的带吗？
38.en: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?

38.zh: 你能按时领出十二宫吗？ 能引导北斗和随它的众星吗？
38.en: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?

38.zh: 你知道天的定例吗？ 能使地归在天的权下吗？
38.en: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?

38.zh: 你能向云彩扬起声来， 使倾盆的雨遮盖你吗？
38.en: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?

38.zh: 你能发出闪电，叫它行去， 使它对你说：我们在这里？
38.en: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?

38.zh: 谁将智慧放在怀中？ 谁将聪明赐于心内？
38.en: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?

38.zh: 谁能用智慧数算云彩呢？ 尘土聚集成团，土块紧紧结连； 那时，谁能倾倒天上的瓶呢？
38.en: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,
when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?

38.zh: 母狮子在洞中蹲伏， 少壮狮子在隐密处埋伏； 你能为它们抓取食物， 使它们饱足吗？
38.en: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?

38.zh: 乌鸦之雏因无食物飞来飞去，哀告　神； 那时，谁为它预备食物呢？
38.en: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?

39.zh: 山岩间的野山羊几时生产，你知道吗？ 母鹿下犊之期，你能察定吗？
39.en: “Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?

39.zh: 它们怀胎的月数，你能数算吗？ 它们几时生产，你能晓得吗？
39.en: Can you count the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?

39.zh: 它们屈身，将子生下， 就除掉疼痛。
39.en: They bow themselves. They bear their young. They end their labor pains.

39.zh: 这子渐渐肥壮，在荒野长大， 去而不回。
39.en: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.

39.zh: 谁放野驴出去自由？ 谁解开快驴的绳索？
39.en: “Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,

39.zh: 我使旷野作它的住处， 使咸地当它的居所。
39.en: whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?

39.zh: 它嗤笑城内的喧嚷， 不听赶牲口的喝声。
39.en: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.

39.zh: 遍山是它的草场； 它寻找各样青绿之物。
39.en: The range of the mountains is his pasture. He searches after every green thing.

39.zh: 野牛岂肯服事你？ 岂肯住在你的槽旁？
39.en: “Will the wild ox be content to serve you? Or will he stay by your feeding trough?

39.zh: 你岂能用套绳将野牛笼在犁沟之间？ 它岂肯随你耙山谷之地？
39.en: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you?

39.zh: 岂可因它的力大就倚靠它？ 岂可把你的工交给它做吗？
39.en: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? Or will you leave to him your labor?

39.zh: 岂可信靠它把你的粮食运到家， 又收聚你禾场上的谷吗？
39.en: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?

39.zh: 鸵鸟的翅膀欢然搧展， 岂是显慈爱的翎毛和羽毛吗？
39.en: “The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the feathers and plumage of love?

39.zh: 因它把蛋留在地上， 在尘土中使得温暖；
39.en: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,

39.zh: 却想不到被脚踹碎， 或被野兽践踏。
39.en: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild animal may trample them.

39.zh: 它忍心待雏，似乎不是自己的； 虽然徒受劳苦，也不[为雏]惧怕；
39.en: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,

39.zh: 因为　神使它没有智慧， 也未将悟性赐给它。
39.en: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.

39.zh: 它几时挺身展开翅膀， 就嗤笑马和骑马的人。
39.en: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.

39.zh: 马的大力是你所赐的吗？ 它颈项上挓挲的鬃是你给它披上的吗？
39.en: “Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?

39.zh: 是你叫它跳跃像蝗虫吗？ 它喷气之威使人惊惶。
39.en: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.

39.zh: 它在谷中刨地，自喜其力； 它出去迎接佩带兵器的人。
39.en: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.

39.zh: 它嗤笑可怕的事并不惊惶， 也不因刀剑退回。
39.en: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.

39.zh: 箭袋和发亮的枪， 并短枪在它身上铮铮有声。
39.en: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.

39.zh: 它发猛烈的怒气将地吞下； 一听角声就不耐站立。
39.en: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet.

39.zh: 角每发声，它说呵哈； 它从远处闻着战气， 又听见军长大发雷声和[兵丁]呐喊。
39.en: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

39.zh: 鹰雀飞翔，展开翅膀一直向南， 岂是借你的智慧吗？
39.en: “Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?

39.zh: 大鹰上腾在高处搭窝， 岂是听你的吩咐吗？
39.en: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?

39.zh: 它住在山岩， 以山峰和坚固之所为家，
39.en: On the cliff he dwells and makes his home, on the point of the cliff and the stronghold.

39.zh: 从那里窥看食物， 眼睛远远观望。
39.en: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.

39.zh: 它的雏也咂血； 被杀的人在哪里，它也在那里。
39.en: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”

40.zh: 耶和华又对约伯说：
40.en: Moreover the LORD answered Job,

40.zh: 强辩的岂可与全能者争论吗？ 与　神辩驳的可以回答这些吧！
40.en: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”

40.zh: 于是，约伯回答耶和华说：
40.en: Then Job answered the LORD,

40.zh: 我是卑贱的！我用什么回答你呢？ 只好用手捂口。
40.en: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.

40.zh: 我说了一次，再不回答； 说了两次，就不再说。
40.en: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”

40.zh: 于是，耶和华从旋风中回答约伯说：
40.en: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind:

40.zh: 你要如勇士束腰； 我问你，你可以指示我。
40.en: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.

40.zh: 你岂可废弃我所拟定的？ 岂可定我有罪，好显自己为义吗？
40.en: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?

40.zh: 你有　神那样的膀臂吗？ 你能像他发雷声吗？
40.en: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?

40.zh: 你要以荣耀庄严为妆饰， 以尊荣威严为衣服；
40.en: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.

40.zh: 要发出你满溢的怒气， 见一切骄傲的人，使他降卑；
40.en: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.

40.zh: 见一切骄傲的人，将他制伏， 把恶人践踏在本处；
40.en: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.

40.zh: 将他们一同隐藏在尘土中， 把他们的脸蒙蔽在隐密处；
40.en: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.

40.zh: 我就认你右手能以救自己。
40.en: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

40.zh: 你且观看河马； 我造你也造它。 它吃草与牛一样；
40.en: “See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.

40.zh: 它的气力在腰间， 能力在肚腹的筋上。
40.en: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.

40.zh: 它摇动尾巴如香柏树； 它大腿的筋互相联络。
40.en: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

40.zh: 它的骨头[好像]铜管； 它的肢体仿佛铁棍。
40.en: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.

40.zh: 它在　神所造的物中为首； 创造它的给它刀剑。
40.en: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.

40.zh: 诸山给它出食物， 也是百兽游玩之处。
40.en: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.

40.zh: 它伏在莲叶之下， 卧在芦苇隐密处和水洼子里。
40.en: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.

40.zh: 莲叶的阴凉遮蔽它； 溪旁的柳树环绕它。
40.en: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.

40.zh: 河水泛滥，它不发战； 就是约旦河的水涨到它口边，也是安然。
40.en: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.

40.zh: 在它防备的时候，谁能捉拿它？ 谁能牢笼它穿它的鼻子呢？
40.en: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?

41.zh: 你能用鱼钩钓上鳄鱼吗？ 能用绳子压下它的舌头吗？
41.en: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?

41.zh: 你能用绳索穿它的鼻子吗？ 能用钩穿它的腮骨吗？
41.en: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?

41.zh: 它岂向你连连恳求， 说柔和的话吗？
41.en: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?

41.zh: 岂肯与你立约， 使你拿它永远作奴仆吗？
41.en: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?

41.zh: 你岂可拿它当雀鸟玩耍吗？ 岂可为你的幼女将它拴住吗？
41.en: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?

41.zh: 搭伙的[渔夫]岂可拿它当货物吗？ 能把它分给商人吗？
41.en: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?

41.zh: 你能用倒钩枪扎满它的皮， 能用鱼叉叉满它的头吗？
41.en: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?

41.zh: 你按手在它身上，想与它争战， 就不再这样行吧！
41.en: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.

41.zh: 人指望捉拿它是徒然的； 一见它，岂不丧胆吗？
41.en: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?

41.zh: 没有那么凶猛的人敢惹它。 这样，谁能在我面前站立得住呢？
41.en: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?

41.zh: 谁先给我什么，使我偿还呢？ 天下[万物]都是我的。
41.en: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.

41.zh: 论到鳄鱼的肢体和其大力，并美好的骨骼， 我不能缄默不言。
41.en: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.

41.zh: 谁能剥它的外衣？ 谁能进它上下牙骨之间呢？
41.en: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?

41.zh: 谁能开它的腮颊？ 它牙齿四围是可畏的。
41.en: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.

41.zh: 它以坚固的鳞甲为可夸， 紧紧合闭，封得严密。
41.en: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.

41.zh: 这鳞甲一一相连， 甚至气不得透入其间，
41.en: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

41.zh: 都是互相联络、胶结， 不能分离。
41.en: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.

41.zh: 它打喷嚏就发出光来； 它眼睛好像早晨的光线。
41.en: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

41.zh: 从它口中发出烧着的火把， 与飞迸的火星；
41.en: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.

41.zh: 从它鼻孔冒出烟来， 如烧开的锅和[点着]的芦苇。
41.en: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

41.zh: 它的气点着煤炭， 有火焰从它口中发出。
41.en: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.

41.zh: 它颈项中存着劲力； 在它面前的都恐吓蹦跳。
41.en: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.

41.zh: 它的肉块互相联络， 紧贴其身，不能摇动。
41.en: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.

41.zh: 它的心结实如石头， 如下磨石那样结实。
41.en: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.

41.zh: 它一起来，勇士都惊恐， 心里慌乱，便都昏迷。
41.en: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.

41.zh: 人若用刀，用枪，用标枪， 用尖枪扎它，都是无用。
41.en: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

41.zh: 它以铁为干草， 以铜为烂木。
41.en: He counts iron as straw, and bronze as rotten wood.

41.zh: 箭不能[恐吓它]使它逃避； 弹石在它看为碎秸。
41.en: The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.

41.zh: 棍棒算为禾秸； 它嗤笑短枪飕的响声。
41.en: Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.

41.zh: 它肚腹下[如]尖瓦片； 它如钉耙经过淤泥。
41.en: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

41.zh: 它使深渊开滚如锅， 使洋海如锅中的膏油。
41.en: He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.

41.zh: 它行的路随后发光， 令人想深渊如同白发。
41.en: He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.

41.zh: 在地上没有像它造的那样， 无所惧怕。
41.en: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.

41.zh: 凡高大的，它无不藐视； 它在骄傲的水族上作王。
41.en: He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride.”

42.zh: 我知道，你万事都能做； 你的旨意不能拦阻。
42.en: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.

42.zh: 谁用无知的言语使[你的]旨意隐藏呢？ 我所说的是我不明白的； 这些事太奇妙，是我不知道的。
42.en: You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand, things too wonderful for me, which I didn’t know.

42.zh: 求你听我，我要说话； 我问你，求你指示我。
42.en: You said, ‘Listen, now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you will answer me.’

42.zh: 我从前风闻有你， 现在亲眼看见你。
42.en: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.

42.zh: 因此我厌恶自己， 在尘土和炉灰中懊悔。
42.en: Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”

42.zh: 耶和华对约伯说话以后，就对提幔人以利法说：「我的怒气向你和你两个朋友发作，因为你们议论我不如我的仆人约伯说的是。
42.en: It was so, that after the LORD had spoken these words to Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends; for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.

42.zh: 现在你们要取七只公牛，七只公羊，到我仆人约伯那里去，为自己献上燔祭，我的仆人约伯就为你们祈祷。我因悦纳他，就不按你们的愚妄办你们。你们议论我，不如我的仆人约伯说的是。」
42.en: Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept him, that I not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.”

42.zh: 于是提幔人以利法、书亚人比勒达、拿玛人琐法照着耶和华所吩咐的去行；耶和华就悦纳约伯。
42.en: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did what the LORD commanded them, and the LORD accepted Job.

42.zh: 约伯为他的朋友祈祷。耶和华就使约伯从苦境转回，并且耶和华赐给他的比他从前所有的加倍。
42.en: The LORD restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. The LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.

42.zh: 约伯的弟兄、姊妹，和以先所认识的人都来见他，在他家里一同吃饭；又论到耶和华所降与他的一切灾祸，都为他悲伤安慰他。每人也送他一块[银子]和一个金环。
42.en: Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before, came to him and ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him, and consoled him concerning all the evil that the LORD had brought on him. Everyone also gave him a piece of money, and everyone a ring of gold.

42.zh: 这样，耶和华后来赐福给约伯比先前更多。他有一万四千羊，六千骆驼，一千对牛，一千母驴。
42.en: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.

42.zh: 他也有七个儿子，三个女儿。
42.en: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

42.zh: 他给长女起名叫耶米玛，次女叫基洗亚，三女叫基连·哈朴。
42.en: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.

42.zh: 在那全地的妇女中找不着像约伯的女儿那样美貌。她们的父亲使她们在弟兄中得产业。
42.en: In all the land were no women found so beautiful as the daughters of Job. Their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.

42.zh: 此后，约伯又活了一百四十年，得见他的儿孙，直到四代。
42.en: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.

42.zh: 这样，约伯年纪老迈，日子满足而死。
42.en: So Job died, being old and full of days.
